<a id="state-triggers"></a>
### Triggers

Written as `"trigger": {"type": "<trigger>", ...}` in a reaction ([trigger fields](#interaction-trigger-fields)).

| Trigger | When it fires |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-valueChanged"></a>`valueChanged` | Variable `Trigger.variable` changed while the screen shows. |
| <a id="trigger-actionError"></a>`actionError` | On the current canvas: a failed action chain or cloud subscription. `${result.error}` is `{type, message, action, nodeId}` (no stack or raw service objects). A failure in this reaction reports to the host without recursively firing another actionError reaction. |

<a id="action-setVariable"></a>
### `setVariable` (action): Set variable

Changes variable `variable` (of the screen, or the app): `write`. JSON: `{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "count", "op": "add", "value": "1"}`. A computed variable can't be set. To glide a number to a new value, `AnimateAction` it (`animateTo`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | The variable's name; a path into it sets that part. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |

<a id="action-setValue"></a>
### `setValue` (action): Set value

Sets properties of node `node` at runtime (until the screen goes). A property bound to a variable sets the variable instead.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `values` | Object | unset |  | The properties set: [{"path", "value" \| "mode"}]. |

<a id="action-setVariant"></a>
### `setVariant` (action): Set variant

Shows variant `variant` of variance node `node`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A variance node. |
| `variant` | String | `""` |  | The variant's id (an expression). |

<a id="action-callFunction"></a>
### `callFunction` (action): Call function

Calls a function the app registered by `name` with `params` (text values are expressions). Its result is the chain's `${result}`: what the app's code answered (a permission granted, a share completed), which the next actions branch on. A function the app didn't register fails the chain, unless the action is `optional`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | String | `""` |  | The function the app registered. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Its arguments; text values are expressions. |
| `optional` | bool | `false` |  | A function the app didn't register is skipped (${result} is null) instead of failing the chain. |

<a id="action-if"></a>
### `if` (action): If

Runs `then` when `condition` holds, else `orElse`. JSON: `{"type": "if", "condition": {...}, "then": [...], "else": [...]}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | Object | unset |  | A predicate; null never holds. |
| `then` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it holds. |
| `else` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it doesn't. |

<a id="action-forEach"></a>
### `forEach` (action): For each

Runs `actions` once per item of list `items` (a path or expression). Every action of a turn reads the item and its index as `${loop.item}` and `${loop.index}`; `${result.item}` and `${result.index}` hold them too, until an action of the turn gives a result of its own.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | String | `""` |  | A list (a path or expression). |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}). |

<a id="action-delay"></a>
### `delay` (action): Delay

Waits `ms` milliseconds, or `duration` (a formula giving them) when that gives a number.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ms` | int | `500` |  |  |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | A formula giving milliseconds. |

<a id="action-runScript"></a>
### `runScript` (action): Run script

Runs script `script` (a layout's `scripts`, by id) with `arguments` (by parameter name; expressions: one `${...}` passes its value as is, other text passes as JSON when it is JSON, else as text). Its result is the chain's `${result}` (and goes in `resultVariable` when set). When it fails, `onError` runs with `${result}` `{error: {type, message, line, column}, logs}`; without `onError` a failure stops the chain.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | String | `""` |  | A script of the layout's scripts. |
| `arguments` | Object | unset |  | By parameter name (expressions). |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets the result. |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it fails (${result.error}, ${result.logs}). |

<a id="action-retryFailed"></a>
### `retryFailed` (action): Retry failed actions

In an actionError reaction: runs the failed action chain again.

_No fields._

<a id="state-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="state-computed-and-function-variables"></a>
### Computed and function variables

A variable with a `formula` (what goes in `${= ...}`) is read-only and follows what it reads; with `parameters` it
is a function any formula calls by name. Declare them in `page_variables` to share them with every canvas of the
document:

```json
"variables": {"page_variables": [
  {"name": "query", "type": "text", "value": ""},
  {"name": "dishes", "type": "list", "value": [{"name": "Lamb", "vegan": false}, {"name": "Squash", "vegan": true}]},
  {"name": "shown", "type": "list", "formula": "filter(dishes, d => contains(lower(d.name), lower(query)))"},
  {"name": "shownCount", "type": "integer", "formula": "length(shown)"},
  {"name": "usd", "type": "text", "parameters": ["n"], "formula": "'$' + round(n)"}
]}
```

`${shown}` feeds a list, `${shownCount}` a label, `${= usd(price * 12)}` any text: write a filter or a rule once,
not in every binding. A function variable's name must not be a formula function's (the built-in one wins).

<a id="state-a-streak-and-other-counts-from-data"></a>
### A streak and other counts from data

Derive, do not store: a computed variable over the records. Habits done today: `count(habits, h => h.done)`.
Totals: `sum(map(cart, i => i.price * i.qty))`. Dates: `formatDate(today(), 'EEE d')`, `addDays(today(), -i)`,
`weekday(date)` (Monday is 1). Function variables may call each other. A streak (checked days in a row ending at
day `end` of a list of booleans): the days up to `end`, reversed, and the index of the first unchecked one.

```json
"variables": {"page_variables": [
  {"name": "todayIdx", "type": "integer", "formula": "weekday(today()) - 1"},
  {"name": "gapAt", "type": "integer", "parameters": ["days", "end"], "formula": "findIndex(reverse(take(days, end + 1)), d => !d)"},
  {"name": "streak", "type": "integer", "parameters": ["days", "end"], "formula": "gapAt(days, end) < 0 ? end + 1 : gapAt(days, end)"}
]}
```

`${= streak(item.days, todayIdx)}` in a habit's row; `${= streak(item.days, todayIdx - 1)}` when today is not
checked yet. For anything with a real loop, a script.

<a id="state-changing-state-from-a-reaction"></a>
### Changing state from a reaction

`setVariable` with `op`: `set` (default), `toggle`, `add` (a number adds; a list appends; a map merges),
`subtract`, `insert` / `removeAt` / `update` at `index`, `remove`. `value` is an expression. A chain that branches:
`if` with a `condition` (a predicate: `{"left": "${count}", "op": "greaterThan", "right": "5"}`, `{"left":
"${name}", "op": "isEmpty"}`; every op is in [Conditions](#state-conditions)) and `then` / `else` chains. Every
action also takes `when`, the same kind of predicate object (run only while it holds); a trigger's `when` is a
formula string instead (`"when": "!item.future"`). `forEach` runs a chain per item; `delay` waits.

```json
{"type": "if", "condition": {"left": "${= contains(saved, trip.id)}", "op": "isTrue"},
 "then": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "op": "remove", "value": "${trip.id}"}],
 "else": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "op": "add", "value": "${trip.id}"}]}
```

The condition is an object, never a formula string: a formula goes in `left` with `"op": "isTrue"`.

<a id="state-setting-several-nodes-with-a-condition"></a>
### Setting several nodes with a condition

A condition sets node fields while a test holds: an ordered list of branches (if, else if, ..., else) under a canvas
id in the document's `conditions`. For one field the first branch that holds and sets it wins; a condition wins
over the node's binding. A binding with a formula is often simpler; conditions suit setting several nodes at once.

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["plans"],
  "nodes": {
    "plans": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 300},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["toggle", "price", "note"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 300}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"}
    },
    "toggle": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["toggleLabel"],
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 36}, "padding": [14, 8, 14, 8]},
      "decoration": {"strokes": [{"color": "#FF2563EB"}], "radius": 18},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "annual", "op": "toggle"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "toggleLabel": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 80}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Monthly", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF2563EB"}},
      "bind": {"props.text": "${= annual ? 'Annual billing' : 'Monthly billing'}"}
    },
    "price": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 80}, "height": {"hug": 40}},
      "props": {"text": "$12 / month", "style": {"fontSize": 32, "fontWeight": 700, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 80}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Save 20% with annual billing", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF16A34A"}}
    }
  },
  "variables": {"plans": [{"name": "annual", "type": "boolean", "value": false}]},
  "conditions": {
    "plans": [
      {
        "id": "billing",
        "branches": [
          {
            "when": {"left": "${annual}", "op": "isTrue"},
            "set": [
              {"node": "price", "path": "props.text", "value": "$120 / year"},
              {"node": "note", "path": "visible", "value": false}
            ]
          },
          {"set": [{"node": "price", "path": "props.text", "value": "$12 / month"}]}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="state-when-to-use-a-script"></a>
### When to use a script

For multi-step state changes (a puzzle's checks, a game step, a streak over dates), a script reads and sets
variables with `vars.get(name)` and `vars.set(name, value)` (capabilities `variables.read`, `variables.write`);
the UI updates through what binds to them. A script cannot draw or touch nodes. A reaction runs it (`{"type":
"runScript", "script": "place", "arguments": {"cell": "${index}"}}`); a formula calls a pure one
(`${= script.isSolved(board)}`).

<a id="state-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- `${false}` reads a variable called `false`: a literal is `${= false}`.
- Values in `props`, `layout` and `decoration` are literal: `"opacity": "${x}"` is an error; bind it.
- A backslash in a formula is written twice in JSON: `"${= matches(code, '^\\d{4}$')}"`.
- A component never reads its caller's variables: pass them as parameters.
- Per-breakpoint canvases have separate variables: shared state lives in `page_variables`.
- A function variable named like a formula function is never called (the built-in wins).
- Formula syntax errors and unknown names in formulas are reported by the render command (the SDK parses them).
- A misspelled binding path is `unknown_bind_path`; a name nothing declares is `unknown_name`.

## See also

[interaction](#interaction-reactions) (reactions and triggers) · [data](#page-data) (APIs, storage, cloud data).

<a id="page-interaction"></a>
# Interaction: reactions, states and gestures

<a id="interaction-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

What a node does when it is tapped, hovered, pressed, dragged or swiped: reactions and every trigger, hover and
pressed styles (`states`), ink ripples, tooltips, letting taps through, drag and drop, values set by dragging
(`track`), swipe to dismiss, pan, pinch and rotate, keys, the clipboard and haptics.

<a id="interaction-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A button-like row that changes colour while hovered and pressed, and while selected:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["buttons"],
  "nodes": {
    "buttons": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["cta"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 200}},
      "props": {"mainAxisAlignment": "center"}
    },
    "cta": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["ctaLabel"],
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 160}, "height": {"hug": 44}, "padding": [20, 12, 20, 12]},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FF2563EB"}], "radius": 10},
      "states": {
        "hovered": {
          "cta": {"decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FF1D4ED8"}]}},
          "ctaLabel": {"props": {"text": "Let's go"}}
        },
        "pressed": {"cta": {"opacity": 0.8}}
      },
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "openLink", "url": "https://example.com"}]}]
    },
    "ctaLabel": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 100}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Get started", "style": {"fontSize": 16, "fontWeight": 600, "color": "#FFFFFFFF"}}
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="interaction-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="interaction-trigger-fields"></a>
### Trigger fields

A trigger is `{"type": "<type>", ...these}`, or just the type as a string (`"click"`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | [TriggerType](#enum-TriggerType) | `"click"` |  |  |
| `debounceMs` | int | `0` |  | Waits this long after the last trigger before running, so a burst (typing in a search field) runs once. 0 runs every time. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | `TriggerType.valueChanged`: the variable watched. |
| `intervalMs` | int | `1000` |  | Timer: ms between ticks (a number or an expression). |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | Key triggers: the key or combination (`KeyCombo`); empty: any key. |
| `when` | String | `""` |  | A formula; the reaction runs only while it's true (key triggers take the key only then; a timer or a frame ticker runs only then). Empty: always. |
| `holdMs` | int | `1200` |  | `TriggerType.hold`: how long the press is held. |
| `visibleFraction` | double | `0.15` |  | Viewport triggers: the visible share (0–1) that counts as in view. |
| `repeat` | bool | `false` |  | keyDown: also while the key repeats. |
| `visibleMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Viewport: how long it stays in view before firing (ms). |
| `onceKey` | String | `""` |  | Runs once per key (an expression, such as ${item.id}) per app session. |
| `event` | String | `""` |  | event: the key of the component event it handles (one of the component's widget.events). |

<a id="interaction-fields-every-action-has"></a>
### Fields every action has

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | False skips the action. |
| `nonBlocking` | bool | `false` |  | The chain doesn't wait for it, and its failure doesn't stop the chain. |
| `when` | Object | unset |  | Runs only when it holds. |

Fields holding nested action chains (a list of actions): `then`, `else`, `actions`, `onSuccess`, `onError`, `cancelActions`.

<a id="behavior-states"></a>
### `states` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [StateStyles](#type-StateStyles). Default: `{}`.

Property overrides per interaction state.

<a id="type-StateStyles"></a>
#### StateStyles

What a node and its descendants change to in each `WidgetState`: per state, node id → a patch of that node's JSON (a merge patch: maps merge, `null` removes, anything else replaces; see `mergePatch`). Later states in `WidgetState`'s order win where active states overlap.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hovered` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `focused` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `pressed` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `selected` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `disabled` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |
| `dragged` | NodePatches | unset |  |  |

<a id="behavior-inkWell"></a>
### `inkWell` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [InkWellStyle](#type-InkWellStyle). Default: unset.

Ink: ripples, and hover/focus/press overlays.

<a id="type-InkWellStyle"></a>
#### InkWellStyle

The ink a tappable box shows, as Flutter's `InkWell`: ripples and the overlays of its states. Clipped to the box's radius.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `overlayColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  | Every state's overlay (Flutter's `overlayColor`, for all states). |
| `splashColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `highlightColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `hoverColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `focusColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  |  |

<a id="behavior-tooltip"></a>
### `tooltip` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: String. Default: `""`.

Shown on hover or long press; may hold `${...}` data.

<a id="behavior-ignorePointer"></a>
### `ignorePointer` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: bool. Default: `false`.

Lets pointer events through to what's under the node (Flutter's `IgnorePointer`).

<a id="behavior-draggable"></a>
### `draggable` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [DragSource](#type-DragSource). Default: unset.

<a id="type-DragSource"></a>
#### DragSource

Lets the user pick the node up and drop it on a `DropTarget` that takes its `group` (Flutter's `Draggable`; `LongPressDraggable` with `start` `longPress`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | String | `""` |  | The drag group a `DropTarget` `DropTarget.accepts`, and the data it hands over (`Draggable.data`; may hold `${...}`). |
| `data` | String | `""` |  | The drag group a `DropTarget` `DropTarget.accepts`, and the data it hands over (`Draggable.data`; may hold `${...}`). |
| `start` | [DragStart](#enum-DragStart) | `"auto"` | `press`, `longPress`, `auto` | How a drag starts: press, long press (`LongPressDraggable`), or long press on touch and press with a mouse. |
| `axis` | [DragAxis](#enum-DragAxis) | `"free"` | `free`, `horizontal`, `vertical` | `Draggable.axis`: the feedback moves only along it. |
| `childWhenDragging` | [DragSourceStyle](#enum-DragSourceStyle) | `"ghost"` | `ghost`, `hidden`, `keep` | What stays where it was picked up. |
| `ghostOpacity` | double | `0.35` |  | The opacity of a `DragSourceStyle.ghost`. |
| `feedback` | String | `""` |  | The node drawn under the pointer instead of this one. |
| `dragAnchor` | [DragAnchor](#enum-DragAnchor) | `"child"` | `child`, `center` |  |
| `feedbackRotation` | double | `-2` |  | The feedback's tilt (degrees), scale, opacity and shadow while it follows the pointer. Not yet a `states.dragged` patch: their defaults (−2°, a 24 shadow) can't change under existing documents. |
| `feedbackScale` | double | `1` |  | The feedback's tilt (degrees), scale, opacity and shadow while it follows the pointer. Not yet a `states.dragged` patch: their defaults (−2°, a 24 shadow) can't change under existing documents. |
| `feedbackOpacity` | double | `1` |  | The feedback's tilt (degrees), scale, opacity and shadow while it follows the pointer. Not yet a `states.dragged` patch: their defaults (−2°, a 24 shadow) can't change under existing documents. |
| `feedbackElevation` | double | `24` |  | The feedback's tilt (degrees), scale, opacity and shadow while it follows the pointer. Not yet a `states.dragged` patch: their defaults (−2°, a 24 shadow) can't change under existing documents. |
| `returnSpring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  | The spring an unaccepted drop flies home on; `false`: none. |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Bindable as `draggable.enabled`. |

<a id="behavior-dropTarget"></a>
### `dropTarget` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [DropTarget](#type-DropTarget). Default: unset.

<a id="type-DropTarget"></a>
#### DropTarget

Takes `DragSource`s of the groups it `accepts` (Flutter's `DragTarget`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accepts` | List<String> | `[]` |  | The `DragSource` groups it takes. |
| `key` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `acceptIf` | String | `""` |  | A condition on the dragged data. |
| `listNodeId` | String | `""` |  | The list it drops into, and how. A target outside the list's repeat (a column's tab, beside the columns) drops at the end of the copy of the list whose own target has the same `key`. |
| `slot` | [DropSlot](#enum-DropSlot) | `"gap"` | `none`, `gap`, `node` |  |
| `slotNodeId` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `slotSize` | [DropSlotSize](#enum-DropSlotSize) | `"dragged"` | `dragged`, `node`, `inGap` |  |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  |  |

<a id="behavior-track"></a>
### `track` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [Track](#type-Track). Default: unset.

A value set by dragging (Flutter's `Slider`, along any path).

<a id="type-Track"></a>
#### Track

A value the user sets by dragging (node key `track`): Flutter's `Slider` (`value`, `min`, `max`, divisions as `step`, `onChanged` as the `changed` reaction, `onChangeEnd` as `changeEnd`), generalised from a straight bar to a line, an arc or any path. The node carrying it is the thumb: it moves along the track as variable `variable` goes from `min` to `max`, and the design canvas draws it at the variable's value. Dragging it writes the variable; the wheel and arrow keys step it. Inside it `${track.value}`, `${track.progress}`, `${track.dragging}` and `${track.focused}` can be read; it fires `changed` (`${result.value}`, `from`, `direction`, `crossed`), `dragEnd` and `changeEnd`.

Its settings and geometry are bindable as `track.<field>` (`track.x2`: `${= parent.width - 26}`); `track.value` gives the value the node is drawn at in place of reading `variable`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Off, it takes no pointer, wheel or keys. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | The variable the control sets. |
| `value` | double | unset |  | The value it's drawn at, from a binding; null reads `variable`. |
| `min` | double | `0` |  | The range and its step (`Slider.divisions` = (max − min) / step; 0 is continuous). |
| `max` | double | `1` |  | The range and its step (`Slider.divisions` = (max − min) / step; 0 is continuous). |
| `step` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | The range and its step (`Slider.divisions` = (max − min) / step; 0 is continuous). |
| `clamp` | bool | `true` |  | Off, an arc turns past its ends (a combination dial). |
| `input` | [TrackInput](#enum-TrackInput) | `"follow"` | `follow`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `both` |  |
| `allowedInteraction` | [TrackInteraction](#enum-TrackInteraction) | `"slideThumb"` | `slideThumb`, `tapAndSlide` |  |
| `hitArea` | [TrackHitArea](#enum-TrackHitArea) | `"self"` | `self`, `parent` | With `TrackHitArea.parent` the node's parent takes the pointer too. |
| `pixelsPerRange` | double | `200` |  | Pixels of drag for the whole range (`TrackInput.vertical`, `TrackInput.horizontal`, `TrackInput.both`). |
| `wheelStep` | double | unset |  | Null: the step (else 1% of the range); 0: off. |
| `keyStep` | double | unset |  | One wheel notch, one arrow key: null `step`, else 1% of the range; 0 turns the wheel or the keys off. With the keys on it takes focus: arrows step, Page Up/Down by 10 steps, Home and End to the ends. |
| `shape` | [TrackShape](#enum-TrackShape) | `"line"` | `line`, `arc`, `path` | Inferred from `path` when not given. |
| `x1` | double | `0` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `y1` | double | `0` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `x2` | double | `0` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `y2` | double | `-100` |  | A line's ends, from the node's place (pixels, or with `relative` multiples of the node's size, with `units` parent of the parent's). |
| `relative` | bool | `false` |  | A line's ends are multiples of the node's size. |
| `units` | [TrackUnits](#enum-TrackUnits) | `"pixels"` | `pixels`, `parent` |  |
| `startAngle` | double | `-135` |  | Degrees: the arc's start, and its turn to the end. |
| `sweepAngle` | double | `270` |  | An arc: the angle of `min` (degrees, clockwise, 0 up) and the turn to `max`, about the pivot (from the node's center); the node orbits it on the circle through its place, turning with it (`rotate`). A pivot at the center is a knob that turns in place. |
| `pivotX` | double | `0` |  | An arc: the angle of `min` (degrees, clockwise, 0 up) and the turn to `max`, about the pivot (from the node's center); the node orbits it on the circle through its place, turning with it (`rotate`). A pivot at the center is a knob that turns in place. |
| `pivotY` | double | `0` |  | An arc: the angle of `min` (degrees, clockwise, 0 up) and the turn to `max`, about the pivot (from the node's center); the node orbits it on the circle through its place, turning with it (`rotate`). A pivot at the center is a knob that turns in place. |
| `rotate` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `path` | [PathFollow](#type-PathFollow) | unset |  | A path's SVG data, view box and orientation. |
| `detent` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | How magnetic the steps are while dragging (0–1). |
| `overscroll` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | How far past an end it stretches (0–1). |
| `physics` | [GesturePhysics](#type-GesturePhysics) | unset |  | A fling's coast (fling, friction); null stops where let go. |
| `settle` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | The glide to its value's place when not following the pointer (ms; 0 jumps), its curve, and the spring of `AnimationCurve.spring` (mass 1), which a release mid-fling starts at the pointer's speed. |
| `settleCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeOutCubic"` |  |  |
| `settleSpring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | `{}` |  | The spring of a `spring` `settleCurve` (JSON `settleSpring`). |
| `snap` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Animates the node to each new value over `snap` ms along `snapCurve` (a knob clicking from detent to detent); 0 jumps. |
| `snapCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"easeOutBack"` |  |  |

<a id="behavior-dismissible"></a>
### `dismissible` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [DismissibleBehavior](#type-DismissibleBehavior). Default: unset.

Swiped away (Flutter's `Dismissible`).

<a id="type-DismissibleBehavior"></a>
#### DismissibleBehavior

Swiped away past a threshold (node key `dismissible`): Flutter's `Dismissible`. The node follows the pointer toward its `directions` (held back by `resistance` the other ways); let go past its `dismissThresholds` share of its size, or faster than `flingVelocity`, it flies off over `movementDuration` and fires the swipe of that direction (`swipeLeft`...; `Dismissible.onDismissed`), then shows its next content back at rest. Otherwise it returns: on `returnSpring`, else over `returnDuration` along `returnCurve`. A swipe card.

Inside it `${dismiss.dx}`, `${dismiss.dy}`, `${dismiss.progress}` (0–1 toward the threshold, `Dismissible.onUpdate`), `${dismiss.direction}`, `${dismiss.dragging}` can be read (and the same as `${drag.*}`). It fires `drag` and `dragEnd`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Bindable as `dismissible.enabled`: off, a drag doesn't move it. |
| `directions` | List<[DragDirection](#enum-DragDirection)> | `["left","right"]` | `left`, `right`, `up`, `down` | The directions it can be dismissed in. |
| `axis` | [DragAxis](#enum-DragAxis) | `"free"` | `free`, `horizontal`, `vertical` | The axis it moves on (`Draggable.axis`); free moves it both ways, the ones it can't be dismissed in held back by `resistance`. |
| `dismissThresholds` | DismissThresholds | `{}` |  | Per direction, the share of the node's size to travel (0.4 when not named). |
| `flingVelocity` | double | `700` | ≥ 0 | Pixels per second. |
| `resistance` | double | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | 0–1: how much of the pointer's travel toward a direction it can't be dismissed in is ignored (1 none follows; below 1 a rubber band). |
| `movementDuration` | int | `200` | ≥ 0 | The fly-off (ms, `Dismissible.movementDuration`) and its curve. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"linear"` |  |  |
| `returnDuration` | int | unset |  | Null: `movementDuration` and `curve`. |
| `returnCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | unset |  |  |
| `returnSpring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | unset |  | The spring it returns on, carrying the release's speed; null returns over `returnDuration`. |

<a id="behavior-pan"></a>
### `pan` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [Pan](#type-Pan). Default: unset.

Follows the pointer.

<a id="type-Pan"></a>
#### Pan

Follows the pointer (node key `pan`): `GestureDetector(onPanUpdate:)` moving a `Transform.translate`. On release it springs back to rest or stays (`release`), with `physics` a fling that slows by friction, a spring and snap points within `bounds` and the limits `minX`...`maxY` (a bottom sheet: `{"axis": "vertical", "release": "stay", "minY": -560, "maxY": 0, "physics": {"snap": {"points": [[0, 0], [0, -560]]}}}`). Its offset binds two-way to `xVariable` and `yVariable`; `x` and `y` (bindable) place its rest.

Inside it `${pan.dx}`, `${pan.dy}`, `${pan.dragging}`, `${pan.settling}`, `${pan.snapIndex}` can be read (and the same as `${drag.*}`). It fires `drag` and `dragEnd`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Bindable as `pan.enabled`. |
| `axis` | [DragAxis](#enum-DragAxis) | `"free"` | `free`, `horizontal`, `vertical` | The axis it moves on (`Draggable.axis`, `InteractiveViewer.panAxis`). |
| `release` | [PanRelease](#enum-PanRelease) | `"snapBack"` | `snapBack`, `stay` |  |
| `returnDuration` | int | `450` | ≥ 0 | The spring back without physics. |
| `returnCurve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"spring"` |  |  |
| `x` | double | `0` |  | Its rest, from its layout's place (pixels). |
| `y` | double | `0` |  | Where it rests, from where its layout puts it (pixels; bindable as `pan.x`, `pan.y`): it springs back here, and a new value moves it. |
| `xVariable` | String | `""` |  | Number variables its offset from where its layout puts it is written to (rounded to hundredths) as it moves. |
| `yVariable` | String | `""` |  | Number variables its offset from where its layout puts it is written to (rounded to hundredths) as it moves. |
| `physics` | [GesturePhysics](#type-GesturePhysics) | unset |  | The release's fling, spring and snap points. |
| `bounds` | [GestureBounds](#enum-GestureBounds) | `"none"` | `none`, `contain`, `cover` | What it's kept inside of while dragged and flung, narrowed by the offsets from rest `minX`...`maxY` (null: no limit). |
| `minX` | double | unset |  | Offsets from rest it stays within (pixels; null no limit). |
| `maxX` | double | unset |  |  |
| `minY` | double | unset |  |  |
| `maxY` | double | unset |  |  |

<a id="behavior-transformGesture"></a>
### `transformGesture` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [TransformGesture](#type-TransformGesture). Default: unset.

Pinch, pan and rotate, with fling physics and optional handles.

<a id="type-TransformGesture"></a>
#### TransformGesture

Makes the node pannable, zoomable and rotatable by touch, mouse and trackpad (Flutter's `InteractiveViewer`, and more): pinch and ctrl+wheel zoom about the focal point, one finger pans, two rotate, a double tap zooms to a point; a release flings and settles by `physics` within `bounds` and `minScale`–`maxScale`. The pose binds two-way to variables (`xVariable`...); inside it reads as `${transform.x}`, `${transform.scale}`... Each change runs the node's `changed` reactions, the end of a gesture its `changeEnd` ones.

<a id="interaction-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="interaction-reactions"></a>
### Reactions

A node's `actions` is a list of **reactions**: a trigger and the chain of actions it runs, in order.

- In a chain `${result}` starts as the trigger's event (where a click landed; a text field's text; a checkbox's
  value) and is replaced only by an action that gives a value (`callApi`, `openModal`'s closing value, `runScript`,
  `callFunction`, a cloud read); `setVariable`, `navigate`, `showToast`, `scrollTo` leave it as it was.
- A tap on a control (a checkbox, a switch, a button, a text field) inside a node with a `click` reaction runs the
  control's reaction only, as Flutter's gesture arena gives the tap to the innermost recognizer. To toggle from the
  whole row with one handler, give the control `"ignorePointer": true` and bind its value.
- Screen triggers (`load`, `valueChanged`, `timer`, `frame`, `keyDown`) go on the canvas.
- Every action also takes `enabled`, `nonBlocking` and `when` (run only while a predicate holds:
  `{"left": "${count}", "op": "greaterThan", "right": "5"}`; the ops are in [Conditions](#state-conditions)). A
  trigger's own `when` is a formula string.
- Write each action's fields flat in the action object; a misspelled key is dropped by the runtime and reported by
  validation (`unknown_action_key`).

<a id="interaction-hover-press-and-other-states"></a>
### Hover, press and other states

`states` on a node changes it and its descendants while it is `hovered`, `pressed`, `focused`, `selected`,
`disabled` or `dragged`. Each state maps node ids (the node itself or nodes inside it) to a **patch**: partial node
JSON merged over that node (objects merge, other values replace, `null` removes). `selected` and `disabled` follow
bindings: `"bind": {"selected": "${= tab == 'pricing'}"}` puts the node in its `selected` state. `hovered` needs a
mouse: on touch screens it never happens, so do not hide anything behind it. Animate the change with
`transitions` ([animation](#page-animation)).

<a id="interaction-a-segmented-toggle-monthly-annual"></a>
### A segmented toggle (monthly / annual)

Two labels in a row with a fill; each label's `selected` binds to the variable (`${= annual}` and
`${= !annual}`), its `states.selected` patches its fill and text colour, and its click sets the variable. A
`switch` bound two-way to the same variable works as well.

<a id="interaction-drag-and-drop"></a>
### Drag and drop

`draggable` (`{"group": "card", "data": "${item.id}"}`) lets the node be picked up; a `dropTarget` that `accepts`
the group takes it, and its `drop` reaction reads the data as `${result}`. Reordering a list: the list's `reorder`
settings with a `reorderHandle` in the item, and the `reorder` trigger.

<a id="interaction-values-set-by-dragging-swiping-pinching"></a>
### Values set by dragging, swiping, pinching

`track` sets a variable as the pointer moves along a line, arc or path (a custom slider, a dial). `dismissible`
swipes a node away (a list item; the `swipeAction` trigger). `pan` makes a node follow the pointer;
`transformGesture` pinches, pans and rotates with fling physics. The `drag` trigger reports `${result.dx}`,
`${result.dy}` per move and `dragEnd` the velocity, for game controls.

<a id="interaction-copy-to-the-clipboard"></a>
### Copy to the clipboard

`{"type": "copyToClipboard", "text": "${address}"}` (the key is `text`), then the chain goes on: a toast or a
"Copied" state after it. The render command copies in memory and lists what was copied in its report.

<a id="interaction-keys"></a>
### Keys

A canvas's `keyDown` reaction (`{"trigger": {"type": "keyDown", "key": "ArrowRight"}, ...}`) runs while no text
field has the focus: arrow keys between tabs are two reactions that set the tab variable
(`${= (tabIndex + 1) % 4}`), Escape closing a menu is one.

<a id="interaction-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- `hovered` never happens on touch screens.
- The innermost tappable node takes the tap; `ignorePointer` lets it through.
- A state patch names node ids inside the node; patching a node outside it does nothing.
- An interaction state's patch loses to a binding of the same field (bindings come after states).
- A misspelled trigger is `unknown_trigger`; a key it does not take is `unknown_trigger_key`.
- `tap_no_reaction` (render command): a `--tap` step hit a node with no reaction.

## See also

[navigation](#page-navigation) · [state](#page-state) (what reactions change).

<a id="page-animation"></a>
# Animation and motion

<a id="animation-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Anything that moves: a change that animates (implicit transitions), keyframe animations and presets, moving,
scaling and turning a node without changing layout (`motion`), shared-element flights (`hero`), reveal on
scroll, shimmer, typewriter text, particles, flip cards and tilt, and the timer and frame triggers for clocks and
games.

<a id="animation-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A habit check-off: tapping the circle toggles `done`; its fill and scale change through bindings, and
`transitions` animate the change (a small overshoot), while the label fades.

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["habit"],
  "nodes": {
    "habit": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "row"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 120},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "row": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["check", "label"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 120}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12}
    },
    "check": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": 32, "height": 32},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFE5E7EB"}], "radius": 16},
      "bind": {
        "decoration.fills[0].color": "${= done ? '#FF16A34A' : '#FFE5E7EB'}",
        "motion.scale": "${= done ? 1.15 : 1}"
      },
      "transitions": [
        {"property": "motion", "duration": 250, "curve": "easeOutBack"},
        {"property": "decoration", "duration": 200}
      ],
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "done", "op": "toggle"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 280}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "Drink water", "style": {"fontSize": 17, "color": "#FF111827"}},
      "bind": {"opacity": "${= done ? 0.5 : 1}"},
      "transitions": [{"property": "opacity", "duration": 200}]
    }
  },
  "variables": {"habit": [{"name": "done", "type": "boolean", "value": false}]}
}
```

<a id="animation-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="behavior-motion"></a>
### `motion` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [Motion](#type-Motion). Default: unset.

The transform over the layout (Flutter's `Transform`): its move, scale and rotation are drawn, never laid out.

<a id="type-Motion"></a>
#### Motion

A transform painted over the node's layout (Flutter's `Transform`): it moves nothing else. Its values are the node's rest pose; how it gets there is the node's `animations` and `transitions`.

One matrix, outermost first: a translation (the `path`'s offset, then `translateX`/`translateY` in pixels, then `shiftX`/`shiftY` times the node's size, `FractionalTranslation`), then about `alignment`: the scale (`scale` times `scaleX`/`scaleY`), the rotation `rotate` (degrees, about z, plus the path's turn), then `rotateX` and `rotateY` (3D, seen with `perspective`). JSON (sparse): `{"translateY": -4, "scale": 1.02, "alignment": [0, 1]}`.

Schema 2's other motion keys (`originX`/`originY`, the flat path keys, `opacity`, `blur`, the timing, entrance, loop, spin, keyframes and shimmer) are rewritten by the schema-3 migration (`migrate2to3`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `translateX` | double | `0` |  | Pixels. |
| `translateY` | double | `0` |  | Pixels (`Transform.translate(offset:)`). |
| `shiftX` | double | `0` |  | Times the node's size (`FractionalTranslation`). |
| `shiftY` | double | `0` |  | Multiples of the node's own size (`FractionalTranslation`). |
| `scale` | double | `1` |  | The axis factors multiply `scale`. |
| `scaleX` | double | `1` |  | `Transform.scale(scale:, scaleX:, scaleY:)`: the axis factors multiply `scale`. |
| `scaleY` | double | `1` |  | `Transform.scale(scale:, scaleX:, scaleY:)`: the axis factors multiply `scale`. |
| `rotate` | double | `0` |  | Degrees, about z. |
| `rotateX` | double | `0` |  | Degrees, in 3D. |
| `rotateY` | double | `0` |  | Degrees. `rotate` turns about z (`Transform.rotate`); `rotateX` and `rotateY` turn in 3D, seen with `perspective` (0 flat). |
| `perspective` | double | `1` |  | How strongly a 3D rotation is seen in depth (0 flat). |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](#type-Alignment) | `[0,0]` |  | The point scale and rotation are about (`Transform.alignment`). |
| `backfaceHidden` | bool | `false` |  | Not painted while its back faces the viewer (through every transform above it too). |
| `path` | [PathFollow](#type-PathFollow) | unset |  | A path the node sits on. |

<a id="behavior-animations"></a>
### `animations` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: List<[NodeAnimation](#type-NodeAnimation)>. Default: `[]`.

Its animation controllers.

<a id="type-NodeAnimation"></a>
#### NodeAnimation

One `AnimationController` on a node and the tweens it drives (behavior key `animations`, a list). A screen-wide one sits on the canvas node.

Its value runs 0 → 1 over `duration` (back over `reverseDuration`), after `delay`, eased by `curve` (`CurvedAnimation`), `repeat`ed or once; on a `spring` instead of the clock; or follows `progress` (an expression) with no clock at all. Each track maps that value to its property (`AnimationTrack`).

`preset` names a short form (`pulse`, `shake`, `spin`... see `AnimationPresets`) whose tracks and timing it stands for, with `params`; fields given here override the preset's (`expanded`).

Read as `${animation.<id>.value}` (after `curve`), `.status` (`dismissed`, `forward`, `reverse`, `completed`) and `.isAnimating` by the node and the nodes inside it; driven by the `animate` action.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | `""` |  | Unique on the node; what `animate` and `${animation.<id>}` name. |
| `preset` | String | unset |  | A short form (`AnimationPresets`); its params below. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Off, it applies nothing and doesn't run (the node shows its own values). Bindable. |
| `duration` | int | unset |  | Milliseconds; empty: the preset's, else 300. |

| `ramp` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Ms to speed up from still, and to slow to a stop when paused. |
| `visibleFraction` | double | unset |  | Waits to start until this share of the node is in view. |

<a id="behavior-transitions"></a>
### `transitions` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: List<[Transition](#type-Transition)>. Default: `[]`.

How changes animate, one per property path.

<a id="type-Transition"></a>
#### Transition

How a change of `property` animates (Flutter's implicit animations: `AnimatedContainer(duration:, curve:)`, `AnimatedOpacity`, `AnimatedScale`, `TweenAnimationBuilder`): when the value there changes (a binding, a condition, a state style), the node tweens from what it shows to the new value over `duration` after `delay` on `curve`, or on `spring`. A change mid-flight carries on from where it is. A behavior key, a list: `"transitions": [{"property": "motion", "duration": 240, "curve": "easeOutCubic"}, {"property": "opacity", "duration": 120}]`.

`property` is a binding path or a prefix of one; the longest that matches wins (`motion.rotate` over `motion`), `*` matches every path. A prefix eases what's under it as one value, as `AnimatedContainer` does its `transform`: a change of any of its numbers starts them together, and `keyframes` are passed through each time. A path an animation track is playing isn't transitioned. The design canvas shows new values at once.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `property` | String | `""` |  | A binding path or a prefix of one (`motion`, `motion.rotate`, `opacity`); `*` for every path. |
| `duration` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Milliseconds. |
| `delay` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Milliseconds. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"linear"` |  |  |
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | unset |  | Replaces `duration` and `curve`. |
| `keyframes` | List<[Keyframe](#type-Keyframe)> | `[]` |  | Values passed through on the way (`Keyframe`s, `at` 0–1 of the run): a number for a single property; for a prefix, an object of the numbers under it (`{"at": 0.5, "value": {"scale": 1.05}}`: a card that swells as it turns over). Joined as `interpolation` says. |
| `interpolation` | [KeyframeInterpolation](#enum-KeyframeInterpolation) | `"linear"` | `linear`, `monotoneCubic` |  |

<a id="behavior-shimmer"></a>
### `shimmer` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [Shimmer](#type-Shimmer). Default: unset.

A band of light over what it paints.

<a id="type-Shimmer"></a>
#### Shimmer

A band of light across what the node paints (a loading skeleton's shimmer: Flutter's `ShaderMask` with a moving `LinearGradient`), blended over the node's own pixels only. `position` places it; the `shimmer` animation preset sweeps it across, over and over. JSON (sparse): `{"color": "#FFFFFFFF", "strength": 0.8, "width": 0.44, "angle": 0, "position": 0.5}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | [Color](#type-Color) | `"#FFFFFFFF"` |  |  |
| `strength` | double | `0.8` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 | How strongly the band's center blends the color in (0–1). |
| `width` | double | `0.44` |  | A share of the node's size along the sweep. |
| `angle` | double | `0` |  | Degrees: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom. |
| `position` | double | `0.5` |  | 0 off the start side, 1 off the end (the `shimmer` preset sweeps it). |

<a id="behavior-reveal"></a>
### `reveal` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [Reveal](#type-Reveal). Default: unset.

<a id="type-Reveal"></a>
#### Reveal

Scrolls the node into view when it appears (or when its `reveal.when` binding turns true), to `alignment` of the viewport (0 top, 1 bottom). With `follow` it stays there while the content around it moves (lines added above an end marker, an image that loads late), until the user scrolls away: a chat or transcript pinned to its newest line.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alignment` | double | `0.5` |  | Where in the viewport (0 top, 1 bottom). |
| `duration` | int | `600` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `delay` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `follow` | bool | `false` |  | Stays revealed while the content moves, until the user scrolls away. |

<a id="behavior-typewriter"></a>
### `typewriter` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [Typewriter](#type-Typewriter). Default: unset.

A text that types itself out in a running app.

<a id="type-Typewriter"></a>
#### Typewriter

Text that types itself out in a running app, like a typewriter or a terminal: `charsPerSecond` characters a second after `delayMs`, with a blinking block `caret` after the last one while it types. It types when the text first shows and again from the start when `playKey` changes; when the text grows by appending (a streamed reply) only the new characters type, and when it changes otherwise it types afresh. `skip` (bindable, e.g. to a tap that sets a variable) shows the rest at once; off `enabled` it shows all of it. The layout never changes as it types: the whole text is laid out and only what's typed is painted. The design canvas shows it all.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Off, the whole text shows. |
| `charsPerSecond` | double | `40` | ≥ 0 | Typing speed. |
| `delayMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Wait (ms) before the first character. |
| `caret` | bool | `true` |  | A blinking block after the last character while it types. |
| `caretColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  | Null uses the text color. |
| `caretWidth` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | 0 is about half the font size. |
| `caretHeight` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Centered on the text's middle; 0 is about three quarters of the line. |
| `caretGap` | double | `1` |  | Space between the last character and the caret. |
| `caretAlignStyle` | [TextStyle](#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | With a caret height: the style whose middle it centers on (empty: the text's). |
| `blinkMs` | int | `500` | ≥ 1 | How long the caret stays on, and off. |
| `skip` | bool | `false` |  | Shows the rest at once. |
| `playKey` | String | `""` |  | Types again from the start when it changes. |
| `holdAtMs` | int | unset |  | Stops the typing clock this many ms in (delay included): a part-typed still. Null types to the end. |
| `grow` | bool | `false` |  | Only as tall as the lines typed so far (off: the whole text's size from the start). |

### `particles` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [ParticleEmitter](#type-ParticleEmitter). Default: unset.

<a id="type-ParticleEmitter"></a>
#### ParticleEmitter

Confetti, stars or emoji the node bursts with on cue.

Each particle leaves from the origin at `speed` (55–115%) in a direction within `spread` of `direction`, slows by `drag`, falls by `gravity` no faster than `terminalVelocity`, sways `sway` px side to side, spins and turns over (`flutter`), and fades out over the last `fadeOut` ms of its `lifetime`.

<a id="behavior-flip"></a>
### `flip` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [FlipCard](#type-FlipCard). Default: unset.

A two-sided card that turns over (a runtime 3D turn, not a mirror).

<a id="type-FlipCard"></a>
#### FlipCard

Makes the node a two-sided card (node key `flip`; a runtime 3D turn, not a mirror): its first child is the front, its second the back, turned 180° in advance; each hides while it faces away. The turn is the node's own `Motion` (rotateY, or rotateX for `FlipAxis.x`, 0 or 180), with its perspective, duration (600 ms without one), curve and keyframes. Inside the card `${flip.flipped}` and `${flip.progress}` (0 front, 1 back) can be read.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | [FlipAxis](#enum-FlipAxis) | `"y"` | `y`, `x` |  |

Tilts the node in 3D toward the pointer while it hovers or drags over it. `max` holds the `Motion` values reached with the pointer at an edge: the edge under it tips away (rotateX at the top and bottom, rotateY at the sides, with its perspective); scale and translate are reached while the pointer is over the node at all. A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [ViewProgress](#type-ViewProgress). Default: unset.

<a id="type-ViewProgress"></a>

How far the node has scrolled through the viewport of the scrolling row or column (or list) it is in, as `${view.progress}` (0–1) and `${view.visible}` for its own bindings and the nodes inside it: a figure that draws itself as it scrolls up the screen (a path's `trimEnd`), a heading that fades in, a gauge reading how far through a section the reader is. Positions are fractions of the viewport's extent from its leading edge (0 top, 1 bottom), plus `offset` pixels. With `variable`, the progress is also written to that screen (or app) variable, under `key` when it's a map, for nodes elsewhere to read. The design canvas reads progress 0 above the fold and 1 for a node it shows whole.

<a id="animation-triggers"></a>
### Triggers

Written as `"trigger": {"type": "<trigger>", ...}` in a reaction ([trigger fields](#interaction-trigger-fields)).

| Trigger | When it fires |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-timer"></a>`timer` | Every `Trigger.intervalMs` while the screen shows (`Timer.periodic`) and `Trigger.when` holds; `${result.tick}` counts. |
| <a id="trigger-frame"></a>`frame` | Every frame while the node is on stage and `Trigger.when` holds (a `Ticker`): `${result.dt}` (ms since the tick this chain last got), `${result.elapsed}` (ms since it started), `${result.frame}`. A frame that comes while the chain still runs is skipped; its time goes to the next `dt`. A design canvas never ticks. |

<a id="action-animate"></a>
### `animate` (action): Animate

Drives an animation (Flutter's `AnimationController` methods): node `node`'s `animation` (`NodeAnimation`), or the number variable `variable` (an unbounded controller the screen keeps for it). JSON: `{"type": "animate", "node": "card", "animation": "pop", "command": "forward", "from": "0"}`, `{"type": "animate", "variable": "shownTotal", "command": "animateTo", "target": "${total}", "duration": "800", "curve": "easeOutCubic"}`. The chain waits for it to end (`TickerFuture`) unless it's `nonBlocking`; a repeat ends when its count does.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A node id or key; empty: the reacting node. |
| `animation` | String | `""` |  | The animation's id on the node. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | Instead of a node: a number variable. |
| `command` | [AnimateCommand](#enum-AnimateCommand) | `"forward"` | `forward`, `reverse`, `toggle`, `repeat`, `stop`, `reset`, `animateTo`, `animateBack`, `set` |  |
| `from` | String | `""` |  | Where forward/reverse start (an expression). |
| `target` | String | `""` |  | animateTo, animateBack, set (an expression). |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | Milliseconds (an expression); empty: the animation's. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](#enum-AnimationCurve) | unset |  | Null: the animation's (linear for a variable). |
| `spring` | [Spring](#type-Spring) | unset |  | `animateWith(SpringSimulation)` toward `target` instead of a duration. |

<a id="animation-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="animation-animate-a-change-transitions"></a>
### Animate a change (transitions)

`transitions` is Flutter's implicit animation: when the value at a path changes (a binding, a condition, a state
patch), the node tweens from what it shows to the new value. One entry per path or prefix: `{"property": "motion",
"duration": 250, "curve": "easeOutBack"}`, `"opacity"`, `"decoration"`, `"layout.height"`; `"*"` for every path.
This is the simplest way to animate a check-off, a selected card or an opening panel.

<a id="animation-move-scale-or-turn-without-changing-layout-motion"></a>
### Move, scale or turn without changing layout (motion)

`motion` is a transform painted over the node's layout (Flutter's `Transform`): `translateX`/`translateY` in pixels,
`scale`, `rotate` in degrees, 3D `rotateX`/`rotateY` with `perspective`, about `alignment` (the center by default).
It is the one way to scale or turn a node: there is no node `scale` and no `layout.rotation` (a turned node keeps
its unturned box in the layout, as `Transform.rotate` does; Flutter's `RotatedBox` has no counterpart). Nothing else
moves. Bind a field (`"motion.rotate": "${= open ? 180 : 0}"`) and add a transition to animate it; a transition on
`motion.scale` times the scale apart from the rest of the motion (`AnimatedScale` beside `AnimatedSlide`).

<a id="animation-play-an-animation-animations-and-presets"></a>
### Play an animation (animations and presets)

`animations` holds a node's controllers: each runs 0 → 1 over `duration` (or a `spring`), after `delay`, once or
`repeat`ed, and drives `tracks` of keyframes on its paths. A `preset` names a ready-made one (fade in, slide up,
pulse...) with its `params`. `autoplay` false waits for the `animate` action (`forward`, `reverse`, `stop`...) or a
change of `playKey`. A screen-wide animation sits on the canvas.

<a id="animation-reveal-on-scroll-view-progress-sticky-effects"></a>
### Reveal on scroll, view progress, sticky effects

An entrance when a node scrolls into view (CSS scroll-reveal) is an **animation with `visibleFraction`**: it waits
until that share of the node is in view, then plays.

```json
"animations": [{"id": "enter", "duration": 600, "curve": "easeOut", "visibleFraction": 0.3,
                "tracks": [{"path": "opacity", "from": 0, "to": 1}, {"path": "motion.translateY", "from": 24, "to": 0}]}]
```

The `reveal` behavior is not an entrance, despite its name: it **scrolls** the node into view (a chat's newest
line). `viewProgress` gives `${view.progress}` (0–1 through the viewport) to bind to, for effects that follow the
scroll; the `enterViewport` and `exitViewport` triggers run actions. A page's reading progress:
[scroll progress](#layout-scroll-progress).

<a id="animation-shared-elements-hero"></a>
### Shared elements (hero)

`hero` is Flutter's `Hero`: a tag (`"hero": "avatar-${item.id}"`) flies the node from its place on the screen a
navigation leaves to the node with the same tag on the screen it opens; `flightShuttle` picks what flies (`morph`,
`containerTransform`...). With `"flies": "inPlace"` it flies when it appears instead, from where the node with its
tag was a moment ago on screen (a picked emoji flying from its picker to its chip, a card dropped into a column):
`{"hero": {"tag": "react", "flies": "inPlace", "flight": {"duration": 720, "lift": 110}}}`, on a spring without a
`flight`.

<a id="animation-clocks-and-game-loops"></a>
### Clocks and game loops

A canvas's `timer` trigger (`"intervalMs": 1000`, `"when"`: a formula that must hold) runs every interval
(`${result.tick}` counts); `frame` runs every frame while `when` holds (`${result.dt}` ms since the last), for
physics and game loops. Keep the state in variables and the work in a script when it has several steps.

A clock written by a timer (`"value": "${= now()}"`) changes in every capture. To check a countdown's states, pin
the time with the render command's `--now 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z` (`now()` returns it, so the timer writes it); a
`--set clock=...` also holds against the timer for the capture. No test-only variable is needed.

<a id="animation-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- `motion` (its scale and rotate too) does not change layout: neighbours do not move. To make room, animate a
  layout field.
- A transition animates changes only; a value that never changes needs an animation that autoplays.
- An animation's `id` is what `animate` names; without `autoplay` it waits.
- Animations run in a running app. The render command settles about a second after each step, so a short
  animation is over when it captures; to check one mid-flight, lengthen its duration in a copy.

<a id="animation-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Interaction](#page-interaction) (state changes to animate) · [layout](#layout-overlap-and-bleed) (motion for
overlap) · [navigation](#page-navigation) (route transitions) · [decoration](#page-decoration) (custom drawing).
