<a id="page-components"></a>
# Components and sections

<a id="components-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Splitting a page into parts, each a file: a component used in several places with different values (a card, a
chip, a row), a section used once (a header, a hero, an FAQ), their parameters (every kind, `variable` included),
slots and events, the site manifest, and when to use a component, a list template or a section.

<a id="components-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A definition (`components/Chip.json`; the file is named after the type):

```json
{"schema": 3, "id": "Chip", "roots": ["chip"],
 "widget": {"type": "Chip", "doc": "A label with a remove button.", "children": "list", "slots": ["leading"],
   "props": [
     {"key": "label", "type": {"kind": "string", "flutter": "String"}, "default": "Chip", "required": true},
     {"key": "selected", "type": {"kind": "variable", "of": {"kind": "boolean", "flutter": "bool"}}, "default": ""}],
   "events": [{"key": "onRemove", "payload": {"kind": "string", "flutter": "String"}}]},
 "variables": {"chip": [{"name": "hovered", "type": "boolean", "value": false}]},
 "previews": [{"name": "Selected", "size": [240, 48], "props": {"label": "Design", "selected": true}}],
 "nodes": {
  "chip": {"type": "row", "children": ["lead", "text", "extra", "remove"], "props": {"spacing": 6},
           "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": 36, "padding": [12, 0, 8, 0]},
           "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFE8EAF6"}], "radius": 18},
           "bind": {"decoration.fills[0].color": "${= props.selected ? '#FF3F51B5' : '#FFE8EAF6'}"},
           "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"},
                        "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "props.selected", "op": "toggle"}]}]},
  "lead": {"type": "slot", "props": {"name": "leading"}},
  "text": {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "${props.label}", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF1A237E"}},
           "layout": {"width": {"hug": 60}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
           "bind": {"props.style.color": "${= props.selected ? '#FFFFFFFF' : '#FF1A237E'}"}},
  "extra": {"type": "slot"},
  "remove": {"type": "icon", "props": {"icon": "close", "color": "#FF5C6BC0"},
             "layout": {"width": 20, "height": 20},
             "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"},
                          "actions": [{"type": "componentEvent", "event": "onRemove", "value": "${props.label}"}]}]}
 }}
```

And calls to it, in a page's `nodes` (the page declares `tag` and `removed`):

```json
"nodes": {
  "design": {"type": "Chip", "props": {"label": "Design", "selected": "tag"},
             "slots": {"leading": "dot"}, "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": 36},
             "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "event", "event": "onRemove"},
                          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "removed", "value": "${result}"}]}]},
  "dot": {"type": "box", "layout": {"width": 8, "height": 8}, "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FF4CAF50"}], "radius": 4}},
  "tags": {"type": "listView", "children": ["tagChip"], "bind": {"data": "${tags}"},
           "props": {"scrollDirection": "horizontal", "spacing": 8}, "layout": {"width": {"fill": 360}, "height": 36}},
  "tagChip": {"type": "Chip", "bind": {"props.label": "${item.name}"}, "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"fill": 36}}}
}
```

<a id="components-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="components-parameter-kinds"></a>
### Parameter kinds

Declared in `widget.props` as the catalog declares any prop: `key`, `type` (`kind` and the
Flutter type; `min`, `max`, enum `values`, list `item`), `default`, `doc`, and `"required": true` for one a call
must set. The kinds: `boolean` (`bool`), `integer` (`int`), `number` (`double`), `string` (`String`),
`enumeration` (with `values`), `value` (a value type: `{"kind": "value", "flutter": "Color"}`, also `EdgeInsets`,
`Alignment`, `IconData`...), `list` (with `item`), `object` (a model: `TextStyle`, `Paint`), `json` (any data: a
record, `{"kind": "json", "flutter": "Map<String, dynamic>"}`) and `variable` (with `of`, below). Inside, read them as `${props.<key>}`. A call sets them as any node's props: a literal in `props`, an
expression in `bind` (`"props.label": "${item.name}"`). Validation checks every call against the declaration:
unknown keys, wrong types and bounds, missing required ones, children and slots the component does not take.

<a id="components-the-site-manifest"></a>
### The site manifest

A directory with a `site.json` is a site: its pages, its components and its project variables, read by
bare name in every page and component (a page or component variable of the same name is `duplicate_variable`).

```json
{"schema": 3, "pages": ["pages/home.json"], "components": ["components/Chip.json"],
 "variables": [{"name": "tags", "type": "list", "value": [{"name": "Design"}, {"name": "Code"}]}]}
```

Without `components`, the files under `components/` are the site's components.

<a id="components-validation-codes"></a>
### Validation codes

`unknown_component` (a call to a type no definition declares),
`duplicate_component`, `component_cycle` (a component calling itself, directly or through others),
`component_id_mismatch` (the file is not named after its type), `invalid_component`, `missing_prop`,
`unknown_event`, `call_field_not_allowed`, `slot_outside_component`, `root_placement_bound`. The render command
adds `component_missing` (a call rendered without its definition: an empty box of its size).

<a id="node-slot"></a>
### `slot`

Inside a component: where the call's children (or one named slot) go; its own children show when the call passes none.

Where a definition places what a call passes: the `children` slot (the call's `children`) or a named one (the call's `slots`name``). With nothing passed it shows its own children (the default). Outside a definition it shows its children. Flutter: `child` / `children` / a `Widget title` parameter, placed in `build`.

- Children: `children`.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | String | `"children"` |  | children (the call's children) or a declared slot name. |

<a id="node-external"></a>
### `external`

A widget built by the app.

A widget the app builds (`Codelessly`'s external component builders).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `builderId` | String | `""` |  | The id of the app's builder. |

<a id="node-placeholder"></a>
### `placeholder`

An empty slot (`SizedBox`).

An empty slot shown at design time (Flutter `SizedBox`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `leadingAsset` | String | `""` |  |  |

<a id="node-singlePlaceholder"></a>
### `singlePlaceholder`

A one-child slot.

A slot that shows its one child, or keeps its size when empty.

- Children: `children`.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allowedTypes` | List<String> | `[]` |  | The node types the slot accepts (empty: any) and refuses. |
| `deniedTypes` | List<String> | `[]` |  |  |
| `maxAllowedSize` | [Size](#type-Size) | unset |  | The largest child it accepts, `[width, height]`. |
| `ephemeral` | bool | `false` |  | Its child is temporary (not kept when the slot is filled again). |

<a id="components-triggers"></a>
### Triggers

Written as `"trigger": {"type": "<trigger>", ...}` in a reaction ([trigger fields](#interaction-trigger-fields)).

| Trigger | When it fires |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-event"></a>`event` | On a component call: the component fired its event `Trigger.event` (a `componentEvent` action inside its definition); `${result}` is the event's payload. Flutter: the callback passed to a widget's `onChanged`-style parameter. The handler runs in the caller's scope. |

<a id="action-componentEvent"></a>
### `componentEvent` (action): Fire component event

Inside a component: fires one of its declared events; the call's event reactions run with the value as ${result}.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | String | `""` |  | The key of the event, one of the component's widget.events. |
| `value` | Object | unset |  | The payload (`${result}` in the call's handler): JSON whose strings are expressions. |

<a id="components-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="components-components-are-flutter-widget-classes"></a>
### Components are Flutter widget classes

A page can be split into parts, each in a file of its own: a **component** is a document with one root (not a
canvas) and a `widget` declaration, and a page (or another component) **calls** it with one node whose `type` is
the component's type. A **section** is a component used once. The declaration is the widget's constructor; a
call is `PlanCard(price: 47, ...)`.

| Here | Flutter |
|---|---|
| a component document | a `StatelessWidget` / `StatefulWidget` class, in its own file |
| `widget.props` (parameters) | the constructor's named parameters, with types and defaults |
| a call `{"type": "PlanCard", "props": {...}}` | `PlanCard(...)` in a parent's `build` |
| `${props.price}` in the definition | `widget.price` |
| the definition's own `variables` (one set per instance) | the `State`'s fields |
| a `slot` node, the call's `children` / `slots` | `child`, `children`, `Widget title` parameters, placed in `build` |
| `widget.events`, `componentEvent`, the call's `event` reaction | a `ValueChanged<T>` / `VoidCallback` parameter (`onChanged`) |
| a `variable` parameter | a `ValueNotifier<T>` passed in |
| `site.json` | the app's `lib/`: its pages and its globals |

<a id="components-a-complete-multi-page-site"></a>
### A complete multi-page site

A site of two pages, a modal, a header and a footer shared by reference, written in the order that avoids
`unknown_screen` errors: **the manifest first, every page listed**, then the components, then the pages. The trip
page reads its route parameter (`${route.id}`, from `navigate.params` or a link `trip?id=coast`); the saved list is
restored from storage when the home page loads; the packing list is kept per trip under a key built from the route.

`site.json`:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "pages": ["pages/home.json", "pages/trip.json"],
  "components": ["components/Header.json", "components/Footer.json"],
  "theme": {
    "colors": {
      "ink": "#FF1B1B1B",
      "paper": "#FFFAF7F2",
      "accent": "#FF2F6B4F",
      "muted": "#FF6B7280",
      "line": "#FFE5E1D8"
    },
    "textStyles": {
      "body": {"fontSize": 15, "height": 1.4, "color": "ink"},
      "title": {"from": "body", "fontSize": 28, "fontWeight": 700, "height": 1.2},
      "link": {"from": "body", "fontWeight": 600, "color": "accent"}
    }
  },
  "variables": [
    {
      "name": "trips",
      "type": "list",
      "value": [
        {
          "id": "alps",
          "name": "The Alpine Arc",
          "days": 7,
          "packing": ["Rail pass", "Rain shell", "Walking boots"]
        },
        {"id": "coast", "name": "Coast to Coast", "days": 5, "packing": ["Swimwear", "Sun hat"]}
      ]
    },
    {"name": "saved", "type": "list", "value": []}
  ]
}
```

`components/Header.json` (its About link opens the modal `about`, a canvas of `pages/home.json`; canvas ids are
site-wide, so any page or component may open it):

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "id": "Header",
  "roots": ["bar"],
  "widget": {
    "type": "Header",
    "doc": "The site's top bar: the name (home) and an About link (a modal).",
    "props": [{"key": "savedCount", "type": {"kind": "integer", "flutter": "int"}, "default": 0}]
  },
  "nodes": {
    "bar": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["brand", "count", "about"],
      "props": {"spacing": 16},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 56, "padding": [20, 0, 20, 0]},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "paper"}], "strokes": [{"color": "line"}], "strokeSides": "bottom"}
    },
    "brand": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "Waymark", "style": {"from": "body", "fontWeight": 700}},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "navigate", "to": "home"}]}]
    },
    "count": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "${props.savedCount} saved", "style": {"from": "body", "color": "muted"}, "textAlign": "right"}
    },
    "about": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "About", "style": "link"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "openModal", "to": "about", "presentation": "dialog"}]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`components/Footer.json`:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "id": "Footer",
  "roots": ["foot"],
  "widget": {"type": "Footer", "doc": "The site's footer, on every page."},
  "nodes": {
    "foot": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["copy", "all"],
      "props": {"mainAxisAlignment": "spaceBetween"},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 64, "padding": [20, 0, 20, 0]},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "line"}]}
    },
    "copy": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "Waymark, slow travel by rail", "style": {"from": "body", "color": "muted"}}
    },
    "all": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "All trips", "style": "link"},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "navigate", "to": "home"}]}]
    }
  }
}
```

`pages/home.json`: restores `saved` on `load`, lists the trips from the project variable, links each to `trip`
with its id, and holds the `about` modal canvas:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["home", "about"],
  "nodes": {
    "home": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "name": "Home",
      "path": "/",
      "slots": {"body": "page"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 844},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "paper"}]},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "load"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "value": "${= coalesce(storage.saved, [])}"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "page": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["header", "main", "footer"],
      "props": {"scrollable": true},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 844}}
    },
    "header": {
      "type": "Header",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 56},
      "bind": {"props.savedCount": "${= length(saved)}"}
    },
    "main": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["title", "tripList"],
      "props": {"spacing": 16, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"hug": 300}, "padding": 20, "constraints": {"maxWidth": 960}}
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 350}, "height": {"hug": 34}},
      "props": {"text": "Trips by rail", "style": "title"}
    },
    "tripList": {
      "type": "listView",
      "children": ["tripCard"],
      "props": {"scrollable": false, "spacing": 12},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 350}, "height": {"hug": 200}},
      "bind": {"data": "${trips}"}
    },
    "tripCard": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["tripName", "tripDays"],
      "props": {"mainAxisAlignment": "spaceBetween"},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 350}, "height": 64, "padding": [16, 0, 16, 0]},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}], "strokes": [{"color": "line"}], "radius": 12},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "navigate", "to": "trip", "params": {"id": "${item.id}"}}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "tripName": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 200}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "${item.name}", "style": {"from": "body", "fontWeight": 600}}
    },
    "tripDays": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 60}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "${item.days} days", "style": {"from": "body", "color": "muted"}}
    },
    "footer": {"type": "Footer", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 64}},
    "about": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "name": "About",
      "slots": {"body": "aboutBody"},
      "layout": {"width": 320, "height": 180},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}], "radius": 16}
    },
    "aboutBody": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["aboutText", "aboutClose"],
      "props": {"spacing": 16, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 320}, "height": {"fill": 180}, "padding": 24}
    },
    "aboutText": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 272}, "height": {"hug": 44}},
      "props": {"text": "Itineraries for travelling slowly by train.", "style": "body"}
    },
    "aboutClose": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": 120, "height": 40},
      "props": {"label": "Close"},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "closeModal"}]}]
    }
  }
}
```

`pages/trip.json`: the trip named by `${route.id}` (the first one when the screen opens without it), a Save button
that writes the saved list back to storage, and a packing checklist per trip (`setStorage` key
`packed.${route.id}`, read with `get(storage.packed, route.id)`):

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["trip"],
  "variables": {
    "trip": [
      {"name": "trip", "type": "map", "formula": "coalesce(find(trips, 'id', route.id), first(trips))"},
      {"name": "isSaved", "type": "boolean", "formula": "contains(saved, trip.id)"}
    ]
  },
  "nodes": {
    "trip": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "name": "Trip",
      "path": "/trip",
      "slots": {"body": "page"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 844},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "paper"}]}
    },
    "page": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["header", "main", "footer"],
      "props": {"scrollable": true},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 844}}
    },
    "header": {
      "type": "Header",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 56},
      "bind": {"props.savedCount": "${= length(saved)}"}
    },
    "main": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["back", "title", "save", "packTitle", "packList"],
      "props": {"spacing": 16, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"hug": 400}, "padding": 20, "constraints": {"maxWidth": 960}}
    },
    "back": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "Back", "style": "link"},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "navigate", "mode": "pop"}]}]
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 350}, "height": {"hug": 34}},
      "props": {"text": "${trip.name}", "style": "title"}
    },
    "save": {
      "type": "outlinedButton",
      "layout": {"width": 160, "height": 40},
      "props": {"label": "Save trip"},
      "bind": {"props.label": "${= isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Save trip'}"},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {
              "type": "if",
              "condition": {"left": "${isSaved}", "op": "isTrue"},
              "then": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "op": "remove", "value": "${trip.id}"}],
              "else": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "op": "add", "value": "${trip.id}"}]
            },
            {"type": "setStorage", "key": "saved", "valueType": "list", "value": "${saved}"},
            {"type": "showToast", "message": "${= isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Removed'}"}
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "packTitle": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "Packing list", "style": {"from": "body", "fontWeight": 700}}
    },
    "packList": {
      "type": "listView",
      "children": ["packRow"],
      "props": {"scrollable": false, "spacing": 8},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 350}, "height": {"hug": 120}},
      "bind": {"data": "${trip.packing}"}
    },
    "packRow": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["packBox", "packName"],
      "props": {"spacing": 12},
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 350}, "height": 32},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {
              "type": "if",
              "condition": {"left": "${= contains(coalesce(get(storage.packed, route.id), []), item)}", "op": "isTrue"},
              "then": [
                {
                  "type": "setStorage",
                  "key": "packed.${route.id}",
                  "valueType": "list",
                  "op": "remove",
                  "value": "${item}"
                }
              ],
              "else": [
                {
                  "type": "setStorage",
                  "key": "packed.${route.id}",
                  "valueType": "list",
                  "op": "add",
                  "value": "${item}"
                }
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "packBox": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": 20, "height": 20},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}], "strokes": [{"color": "accent"}], "strokeWidth": 2, "radius": 4},
      "bind": {
        "decoration.fills[0].color": "${= contains(coalesce(get(storage.packed, route.id), []), item) ? '#FF2F6B4F' : '#FFFFFFFF'}"
      }
    },
    "packName": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 200}, "height": {"hug": 22}},
      "props": {"text": "${item}", "style": "body"}
    },
    "footer": {"type": "Footer", "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 64}}
  }
}
```

Node ids are per document: both pages have `page`, `header`, `main` and `footer`, and each component its own ids.
Render it and check each state: `--tap tripCard#1 --tap packRow#0 --tap save --label saved`; `--navigate
trip?id=coast`; `--tap header/about --label about` (a node in a component instance by its call's id).

<a id="components-when-to-make-what"></a>
### When to make what

* **List template**: one shape repeated from data in one parent. When the item is more than about five nodes, or
  appears elsewhere too, make the template one call node (`"bind": {"props.plan": "${item}"}`).
* **Component**: the same structure in two or more places with different values (buttons, cards, chips, rows),
  or a part others will reuse. Data comes in as parameters. Four near-identical columns of a table, or three plan
  cards, are one component (or one list template) called four or three times, not four copies.
* **Section**: a top-level band of a page (header, hero, plans, FAQ, footer), in its own file when it is more
  than about 15 nodes or someone will edit it alone, even if it is used once. Parameters only for what it shares
  with its page (`variable` parameters for state both change).

<a id="components-what-a-definition-reads"></a>
### What a definition reads

Its parameters (`props`), its own variables (one set per instance: two chips are
hovered apart), the project's variables (`site.json`, below) and the runtime's scopes (`screen`, `route`,
`theme`, `auth`...); inside its own lists, `item` and `index`. **Never the caller's variables**: the same chip works
on any page. What a section needs from its page comes in as a parameter.

<a id="components-computed-values-inside-a-definition"></a>
### Computed values inside a definition

A definition's own variables may be computed from its parameters: `{"name": "over", "type": "boolean", "formula":
"props.seats > props.limit"}` under the root's id in its `variables`, then `${over}` in any of its nodes. One rule,
read by five nodes, written once.

<a id="components-shared-state-variable-parameters"></a>
### Shared state: variable parameters

share state with the caller: `{"kind": "variable", "of": {"kind": "boolean"}}`. The
call passes the *name* of one of its variables (`"selected": "tag"`); inside, `${props.selected}` reads it live and
`setVariable "props.selected"` writes it. A header and a menu both taking `"menuOpen": "menuOpen"` open and close
the page's one menu.

<a id="components-slots"></a>
### Slots

A `slot` node in the definition is replaced by what the call passes: the call's `children` for the
slot named `children` (the default name; declare `"children": "list"`), or the call's `slots[name]` for a named
slot (declare it in `widget.slots`). With nothing passed, the slot shows its own children. What is passed belongs
to the caller: it is stored in the page and reads the page's variables.

<a id="components-events"></a>
### Events

Declared in `widget.events`; fired inside with `{"type": "componentEvent", "event": "onRemove",
"value": ...}`; handled by the call's reaction `{"trigger": {"type": "event", "event": "onRemove"}}`, which runs in
the caller's scope with the value as `${result}`. An event nobody handles does nothing.

<a id="components-size-and-place"></a>
### Size and place

The call and the definition's root are one box: the call's `layout` sizes and places it
(width, height, flex, margin, x/y, align, constraints); the root keeps its padding, decoration and contents. A call
has no `decoration` and no `layout.padding`. The root's own size is the design size its previews and new calls
use. `visible` hides the instance when either the call or the root is hidden. The root's own placement (its
`margin`, `flex`, `align`, `x`/`y`, bound or patched) is not read: place the instance from the call (a margin that
depends on a parameter is bound on the call, `"bind": {"layout.margin": "${= item.popular ? [0, 0, 0, 0] : [0, 28,
0, 0]}"}`).

<a id="components-ids-and-paths"></a>
### Ids and paths

A definition's ids are its own (`text`, `remove`); a page may use the same ids, and
diagnostics name a node of an instance by its path, so the two never mix. An action inside a definition that names
a node (`scrollTo`, `animate`, `focus`) acts on that node of its own instance: two cards each scroll their own
list. Tools name a
node inside an instance by its **path**: the call ids from the page down, then the node's id
(`design/remove`, `plans/card1/cta`); `#n` picks the n-th copy a list repeats (`tagChip#2/text`).

<a id="components-rendering-one-part"></a>
### Rendering one part

`tool/render/render.sh site --out out --component Chip` renders the component alone, once
per preview at its size; `--props '{"label": "Long label"}'` renders one parameter set at each size, and
`--slots fixture.json` (`{"children": [ids], "slots": {"leading": id}, "nodes": {...}}`) passes slot content.
Steps take paths: `--tap design/remove`.

`--components-all` renders every component of the site that way in one run (`<Type>-<preview>@<w>x<h>.png`):
the quickest look at every part a page can call.

<a id="components-per-instance"></a>
### Per instance

Everything a definition keeps is kept per instance, as a Flutter `State` is: its variables, its
interaction states, the values a `setValue` (or `setVariant`) sets on its nodes (set inside an instance, they change
that instance's node only). A variable with `"persist": true` is kept per instance path
(`codelessly.component.<Type>.<path>.<name>` in the app's storage). When an instance leaves the screen (a list
item scrolled away, data that shrank), what it kept goes with it, as a `State` is disposed; shown again, it starts
afresh (a persisted variable from its stored value).

<a id="components-published-components"></a>
### Published components

A published site carries its components beside its pages (each at
`publish/{project}/components/{Type}`, with a version and a digest; a bundle holds them in its `components` map),
and an app loads the ones a screen calls with the screen, caches them, and follows a republished one: every
instance updates where it is, without reloading the pages that call it. Nothing to write in the app: a
`CodelesslyWidget` showing a published site with components just works. A call whose component can't be loaded
is an empty box of its size until it arrives (`component_missing` in the app's error log).

<a id="components-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- A definition never reads its caller's variables: pass values as parameters, shared state as a `variable`
  parameter.
- A slot inside a list of the definition shows what the call passes once per item, built in the caller's scope:
  it reads the caller's variables, not the item. To show the item, make it a parameter of a component the list
  calls.
- A call has no `decoration` and no `layout.padding` (`call_field_not_allowed`): style the definition's root.
- The file is named after the type (`component_id_mismatch`).
- `repeated_subtree` (an INFO) means the same subtree of three or more nodes is written several times over: make
  it a component or a list template.

<a id="components-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Lists](#page-lists) (a list template calling a component) · [state](#page-state) · [the render
command](#page-render) (`--component`, `--components-all`) · [publish](#page-publish).

---

<a id="page-charts"></a>
# Charts, gauges and indicators

<a id="charts-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Showing numbers as pictures: progress bars and rings, activity spinners, badges, gauges, bar, line and series
charts, scatter plots and barcodes.

<a id="charts-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A goal's progress as a bar bound to a variable, and a week as a bar chart:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["stats"],
  "nodes": {
    "stats": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 300},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["goal", "bar", "week"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 300}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "spacing": 12}
    },
    "goal": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "${done} of 7 days", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "bar": {
      "type": "progressBar",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 10},
      "props": {"max": 7, "color": "#FF16A34A", "backgroundColor": "#FFE5E7EB", "borderRadius": 5},
      "bind": {"props.value": "${done}"}
    },
    "week": {
      "type": "barChart",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 160},
      "props": {
        "values": [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0],
        "labels": ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"],
        "color": "#FF16A34A",
        "labelFontFamily": "Roboto"
      }
    }
  },
  "variables": {"stats": [{"name": "done", "type": "integer", "value": 4}]}
}
```

<a id="charts-reference"></a>

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

<a id="charts-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="charts-progress-from-state"></a>
### Progress from state

Bind the value (`"bind": {"props.value": "${done}"}`) with `max` the goal; `"animate": true` eases changes. A ring:
`progressBar` with `"shape": "arc"` (`arcSweepAngle` 360 for a full circle) or `circularProgressIndicator`.

<a id="charts-charts-from-data"></a>
### Charts from data

`barChart` and `lineChart` take plain lists (`values`, `labels`); bind them to computed variables
(`${= map(week, d => d.count)}`). `chart` draws series over data rows (`data`, `series`, `labelField`) as bars,
lines, areas, a timeline or a donut, with a selected index; `plotChart` plots x/y series with markers, ranges and
reference lines.

<a id="charts-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Chart colours default to a dark theme's; set `color`, `gridColor` and the label colours on a light page.
- A `barChart`'s labels default to JetBrains Mono: set `labelFontFamily` to a font you have (`font_fallback`).
- A chart's size is its node's layout: give it a fixed height.
- `value` above `max` is clamped.

<a id="charts-see-also"></a>
## See also

[State](#page-state) (computing the numbers) · [lists](#page-lists) (a table of the same data) ·
[animation](#page-animation).

<a id="page-data"></a>
# Data: APIs, cloud data, storage and form submission

<a id="data-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `data` feature library: calling HTTP APIs, reading and writing the project's cloud documents and files,
storing values on the device, and submitting forms. Not in the agent trust profile at run time (a host enables it).

<a id="data-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A value saved on the device and read back as `${storage.theme}`:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["prefs"],
  "nodes": {
    "prefs": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["saved", "save"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 200}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "spacing": 12}
    },
    "saved": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Saved theme: ${storage.theme}", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "save": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": 160, "height": 44},
      "props": {"label": "Use dark", "style": {"backgroundColor": "#FF111827", "foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {"type": "setStorage", "key": "theme", "value": "dark"},
            {"type": "showToast", "message": "Saved", "style": "success"}
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="data-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="action-callApi"></a>
### `callApi` (action): Call API

Calls API `api` (the publish model's `services.apis`) with `params`, its inputs (expressions; an empty one takes the input's default). Then `onSuccess` runs after a 2xx response, `onError` after any other or a failed request, both reading the response as `${result}`. A failed request without `onError` stops the chain.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | String | `""` |  | An API of services.apis. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Its inputs, by name (expressions). |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run after a 2xx response. |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run after a failure. |

<a id="action-setStorage"></a>
### `setStorage` (action): Set storage

Changes the app's values on the device (read as `${storage.<key>}`). A key may be a path (`prefs.theme`) into a stored map or list.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [StorageOperation](#enum-StorageOperation) | `"write"` | `write`, `remove`, `clear` |  |
| `key` | String | `""` |  | The key; may be a path. Not for clear. |
| `valueType` | [VariableType](#enum-VariableType) | `"text"` | `integer`, `text`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `list`, `map`, `image`, `choice` | How the written value is read (write only). |
| `op` | [WriteOp](#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |
| `skipIfExists` | bool | `false` |  | Leaves a key that has a value. |

<a id="action-cloudDocuments"></a>
### `cloudDocuments` (action): Cloud documents

Writes documents of a cloud collection: one at a time by id, or many at once.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudDocumentsOperation](#enum-CloudDocumentsOperation) | `"add"` | `add`, `update`, `remove`, `removeMany`, `setMany` |  |
| `path` | String | `""` |  | The collection path (an expression). |
| `id` | String | `""` |  | The document id (an expression). |
| `autoId` | bool | `false` |  | Add: a generated id. |
| `skipIfExists` | bool | `true` |  | Add only. |
| `document` | String | `""` |  | The document (add) or documents (setMany): an expression, or JSON text. |
| `raw` | bool | `false` |  | The document is taken as written: no expressions. |
| `field` | String | `""` |  | Update: the field (a path). |
| `valueType` | [VariableType](#enum-VariableType) | `"text"` | `integer`, `text`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `list`, `map`, `image`, `choice` | Update only. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |
| `ids` | String | `""` |  | RemoveMany: ids, comma separated or a list. |
| `whereFilters` | Object | unset |  | RemoveMany: the filters. |
| `idField` | String | `"id"` |  |  |
| `merge` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `replaceCollection` | bool | `false` |  |  |

<a id="action-loadCloudData"></a>
### `loadCloudData` (action): Load cloud data

Streams a cloud document, or a collection query's documents, into variable `variable` while the screen shows: `{status: loading|loaded| error, isLoading, data, error, hasMore}`. A variable of type list gets the documents themselves, and with an `aggregate`, a number variable the number. Blocking actions wait for the first value; an initial failure stops the chain. A later subscription failure stops any remaining actions from that invocation and fires the canvas's actionError reaction. Subscriptions close on error or when the screen is disposed.

One variable has one live load: running the action again (or a `ReloadCloudDataAction`) replaces the earlier subscription. Unless `reactive` is false, the load runs again by itself when a value its query reads changes (`${auth.uid}`, `${search}`, a `limit` bound to a variable), but never for a change of its own variable.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `single` | bool | `true` |  | One document, or the query's documents. |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `query` | Object | unset |  | The collection and, for a query, its filters, sorts, limit and joins (a CloudQueryDef). |
| `scope` | [CloudDataScope](#enum-CloudDataScope) | `"screen"` | `screen`, `app` | Screen: a subscription per screen, until it goes. App: one subscription the whole app shares, into an app variable every screen reads. |
| `limit` | String | `""` |  | The most documents: a number or expression; empty: the query's, else 500; 0: all. |
| `aggregate` | [CloudLoadAggregate](#enum-CloudLoadAggregate) | `"none"` | `none`, `count`, `sum`, `average` | A number (count, sum, average) instead of the documents, without loading them. |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  | Sum and average: the field. |
| `refreshSeconds` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Aggregate: also runs again this often (writes made elsewhere); 0: after this app's writes only. |
| `reactive` | bool | `true` |  | Runs again when a value its query reads changes (${auth.uid}, a bound limit). |

<a id="action-reloadCloudData"></a>
### `reloadCloudData` (action): Reload cloud data

Runs again the live load of `variable` (a `LoadCloudDataAction` that ran on this screen): it subscribes afresh, with the values its query reads now, and waits for the first value. Nothing when the variable has no load. A list's pull to refresh (its `refresh` reaction) runs it.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | A variable a load cloud data action fills. |

<a id="action-cloudFiles"></a>
### `cloudFiles` (action): Cloud files

Uploads files the user picks to (or deletes them from) cloud storage folder `path`; `actions` run with each file (`${result.url}`...). With a `source`, it uploads that value instead of asking the user (a captured screenshot, a drawing).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudFilesOperation](#enum-CloudFilesOperation) | `"upload"` | `upload`, `delete` |  |
| `path` | String | `""` |  | The storage folder. |
| `kind` | [CloudFileKind](#enum-CloudFileKind) | `"image"` | `image`, `any` |  |
| `allowMultiple` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `maxSizeMB` | double | `10` |  |  |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `access` | [CloudFileAccess](#enum-CloudFileAccess) | `"public"` | `public`, `private` |  |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | Uploads this instead of asking the user: a data: URL (${result.image} of a screenshot), or a list. |
| `fileName` | String | `""` |  | The name a source file is stored under. |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run with each file. |

<a id="action-cloudData"></a>
### `cloudData` (action): Cloud data

Creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection. Its result (the new id, the document, the documents, the number) is the chain's `${result}` and goes in `resultVariable`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudDataOperation](#enum-CloudDataOperation) | `"create"` | `create`, `update`, `delete`, `get`, `query`, `count`, `sum`, `average` |  |
| `collection` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `fields` | Object | unset |  | Field writes: [{"field", "value", "operation"}]. |
| `whereFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `orderByFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `limit` | int | unset |  |  |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `loadRelated` | List<String> | `[]` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |

<a id="action-cloudBatch"></a>
### `cloudBatch` (action): Cloud batch

Several `CloudDataAction` writes (create, update, delete) committed at once. With `forEach`, `steps` run once per item of that list (`${loop.item}`, `${loop.index}`), every write in the same commit: "mark all read" in one write instead of one per item.

Up to `kMaxCloudBatchWrites` writes are all or none. More are committed in chunks of that size, each all or none; with `transaction`, more fail before anything is written. A batch with a read step (get, query, count, sum, average) runs its steps one by one, as before.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | Object | unset |  | Nested cloudData actions. |
| `transaction` | bool | `false` |  | All or none: more than 500 writes fail instead of committing in chunks. |
| `forEach` | String | `""` |  | A list: the steps run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}), all in one commit. |

<a id="action-submitForm"></a>
### `submitForm` (action): Submit form

Validates a form's answers and stores them in the app's own variables (`service: local`). See `docs/submit_form.md`.

A remote destination is an explicit later action (`callApi` in `onSuccess`) to an endpoint the app defines; this action itself never calls a service.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | [FormService](#enum-FormService) | `"local"` | `local` | Only `local` is offered: `FormService.unsupported` marks old data. |
| `payload` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. |
| `validationScript` | String | `""` |  | Await a script returning {valid, errors?, payload?}. |
| `validationArguments` | Object | unset |  | Named script argument expressions. |
| `responseVariable` | String | `""` |  | Optional mutable list variable receiving the validated payload. Persist the variable to keep submissions. |
| `prepend` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. An awaited validator may replace it with its normalized `payload`. |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  |  |

<a id="data-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="data-call-an-api-and-show-the-result"></a>
### Call an API and show the result

`callApi` names an API of the publish model (`services.apis`: method, URL, headers, body with `${input}`
placeholders) and passes `params`; its result is `${result}` in `onSuccess` (store it with `setVariable`), the
error in `onError`. Show a loading state with a variable set before the call and cleared in both chains.

<a id="data-cloud-documents"></a>
### Cloud documents

`cloudData` creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection (`whereFilters`,
`orderByFilters`, `limit`); its result goes in `resultVariable`. A list bound to a cloud query loads its pages
through the list's `pagination`.

<a id="data-storage-on-the-device"></a>
### Storage on the device

`setStorage` writes `${storage.<key>}` (a key may be a path into a stored map or list; `op` as `setVariable`'s:
`set`, `add` appends to a list, `insert` puts at an `index`, `remove` takes a value out). A variable with
`"persist": true` is kept on the device too.

- **Restore on load**: a canvas `load` reaction copies storage into a variable, `{"type": "setVariable",
  "variable": "saved", "value": "${= coalesce(storage.saved, [])}"}`; write it back after each change with
  `{"type": "setStorage", "key": "saved", "valueType": "list", "value": "${saved}"}`.
- **A key per page or item** (a checklist per route): the key is an expression, `"key": "packed.${route.id}"` with
  `"op": "add"`, `"valueType": "list"`, `"value": "${item}"`; read it with `${= coalesce(get(storage.packed,
  route.id), [])}`. A persisted variable is one value for every route.
- The render command keeps storage in memory for one run: steps and `--navigate` see what earlier steps wrote; each
  size and each run starts empty.

A whole site using both: [a complete site](#components-a-complete-multi-page-site).

<a id="data-submit-a-form"></a>
### Submit a form

`submitForm` validates the answers and stores them (`service: local`), or sends them to a destination the project
declares; `onSuccess` and `onError` run after. See `docs/submit_form.md` in the package.

<a id="data-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- These actions are not in the agent trust profile: a runtime model may document them but not use them unless the
  host allows the `data` catalog.
- An API's URL and secrets live in the publish model, never in the document.
- `${result}` is the response only inside `onSuccess`.

<a id="data-see-also"></a>
## See also

[State](#page-state) (where results go) · [forms](#page-forms) (validation before submitting) · [auth](#page-auth)
· [lists](#page-lists) (pagination).

<a id="page-auth"></a>
# Auth: signing users in

<a id="auth-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `auth` feature library: signing app users in, up and out, and managing their account, with `${auth}` to show
who is signed in.

<a id="auth-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A sign-in form whose error appears in a text:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["signIn"],
  "nodes": {
    "signIn": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 320},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["email", "password", "error", "go"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 320}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12}
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 56},
      "props": {"decoration": {"labelText": "Email"}, "keyboardType": "emailAddress"},
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${email}"}
    },
    "password": {
      "type": "textField",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 56},
      "props": {"decoration": {"labelText": "Password"}, "obscureText": true},
      "bind": {"props.initialValue": "${password}"}
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 18}},
      "props": {"text": "${authError}", "style": {"fontSize": 13, "color": "#FFDC2626"}},
      "bind": {"visible": "${= authError != ''}"}
    },
    "go": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 48},
      "props": {"label": "Sign in", "style": {"backgroundColor": "#FF2563EB", "foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [
            {
              "type": "auth",
              "operation": "signIn",
              "email": "${email}",
              "password": "${password}",
              "errorVariable": "authError"
            },
            {"type": "navigate", "to": "signIn", "mode": "pop"}
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "signIn": [
      {"name": "email", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "password", "type": "text", "value": ""},
      {"name": "authError", "type": "text", "value": ""}
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="auth-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="action-auth"></a>
### `auth` (action): Auth

Signs app users in, up and out, and manages their account. A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` (and stops the chain).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [AuthOperation](#enum-AuthOperation) | `"signIn"` |  |  |
| `email` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `password` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `displayName` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `photoUrl` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `currentPassword` | String | `""` |  | Re-authenticates first (change password, delete account). |
| `errorVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets a failure's message. |

<a id="auth-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="auth-show-the-signed-in-user"></a>
### Show the signed-in user

`${auth.isSignedIn}`, `${auth.email}`, `${auth.displayName}`, `${auth.initial}`, `${auth.role}` bind like any value: a header shows "Sign in" or
the user's name by `visible` bindings on `${auth.isSignedIn}`.

<a id="auth-errors"></a>
### Errors

A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` and stops the chain: actions after `auth` run only on success.

<a id="auth-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Not in the agent trust profile at run time.
- Keep the password in a variable only as long as the form needs it.

<a id="auth-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Forms](#page-forms) · [data](#page-data) · [navigation](#page-navigation).

<a id="page-commerce"></a>
# Commerce: paywalls

<a id="commerce-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `commerce` feature library: a paywall screen's interactions (buy, restore, select a product, close, open a
legal link).

<a id="commerce-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["upgrade"],
  "nodes": {
    "upgrade": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["buy", "restore"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 200}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12}
    },
    "buy": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 48},
      "props": {"label": "Start free trial", "style": {"backgroundColor": "#FF2563EB", "foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "paywall", "operation": "purchase"}]}]
    },
    "restore": {
      "type": "textButton",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 40},
      "props": {"label": "Restore purchases"},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "paywall", "operation": "restore"}]}]
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="commerce-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="action-paywall"></a>
### `paywall` (action): Paywall

A paywall interaction: buy the selected (or `slot`'s) product, restore purchases, select a product, close the paywall, open a legal `url`, or open a server-resolved `placement`.

`PaywallOperation.openPaywall` shows the placement's screen as a navigation would: with `routeTransition` (a custom transition: a cover from the bottom, a reveal...) or `transition`, `transitionMs` and `reverseTransitionMs`; it plays in reverse when the paywall closes.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [PaywallOperation](#enum-PaywallOperation) | `"purchase"` | `purchase`, `restore`, `selectProduct`, `closePaywall`, `openLegalLink`, `openPaywall` |  |
| `placement` | String | unset |  | The server-resolved placement to open. |
| `offer` | String | unset |  | storeDefault, trial, or standard; expressions allowed. |
| `slot` | String | unset |  |  |
| `url` | String | unset |  | A legal link. |
| `transition` | [PageTransition](#enum-PageTransition) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `none`, `fade`, `fadeUp`, `slideUp`, `slideLeft`, `scale` | openPaywall: how its screen opens. |
| `transitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](#type-RouteTransition) | unset |  | openPaywall: a custom transition for its screen; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="commerce-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="commerce-a-paywall-screen"></a>
### A paywall screen

The products and offers come from the project's paywall placement; the screen is an ordinary canvas whose buttons
run `paywall` operations (`selectProduct`, then `purchase`; `restore`; `closePaywall`; `openLegalLink`).

<a id="commerce-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Not in the agent trust profile at run time.
- Prices shown must come from the store's products, not from text you write.

<a id="commerce-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Navigation](#page-navigation) (presenting the paywall) · [forms](#page-forms) (buttons).

<a id="page-media"></a>
# Media: video, audio, web views, speech and sound

<a id="media-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `media` feature library: video players, embedded videos, an audio player, web views, reading text aloud,
playing sounds, printing, capturing a screenshot, downloading a file and preloading images.

<a id="media-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["watch"],
  "nodes": {
    "watch": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 320},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FF000000"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["clip", "read"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 320}},
      "props": {"spacing": 12}
    },
    "clip": {
      "type": "video",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": 220},
      "props": {"url": "https://example.com/intro.mp4", "showControls": true, "fit": "cover"}
    },
    "read": {
      "type": "textButton",
      "layout": {"width": 200, "height": 40},
      "props": {"label": "Read aloud", "style": {"foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "click"}, "actions": [{"type": "speak", "text": "Welcome to the tour."}]}]
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="media-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="node-video"></a>
### `video`

`VideoPlayer`. Its changed trigger reports ready/error and, when ready, durationSeconds/positionSeconds without autoplay; with reportIntervalMs, also positionSeconds/playing while it plays.

A network video (`video_player`'s `VideoPlayer`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | String | `""` |  | A remote HTTPS MP4, WebM, MOV or M4V URL. |
| `autoPlay` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `showControls` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `playing` | bool | unset |  | Null leaves playback to the built-in controls. Bind or set explicitly to play/pause from application actions; browser gesture rules still apply. |
| `positionSeconds` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Absolute source-media time in seconds; null leaves the current time alone. |
| `volume` | double | `1` | ≥ 0, ≤ 1 |  |
| `loop` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `fit` | [BoxFit](#enum-BoxFit) | `"contain"` | `fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `fitWidth`, `fitHeight`, `none`, `scaleDown` | How the picture fills the node (`FittedBox`): `contain` letterboxes, `cover` fills and crops. |
| `poster` | String | `""` |  | An image URL shown until the video has its first frame (and while a new source loads), instead of a spinner. |
| `syncTolerance` | double | `0.3` | ≥ 0 | While playing, a changed `positionSeconds` seeks only when the video is more than this many seconds away from it, so a position bound to a running clock corrects drift instead of stalling the video with a seek every frame. Paused, every change seeks (the latest one wins). |
| `reportIntervalMs` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | While playing, fires the changed trigger every this many milliseconds with `positionSeconds` and `playing` (0: off): the video as a clock. |

<a id="node-embeddedVideo"></a>
### `embeddedVideo`

An embedded YouTube / Vimeo player (`WebViewWidget`).

A YouTube or Vimeo video, played in a web view.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| `url` | String | `""` |  | The video's page URL. |
| `videoId` | String | `""` |  | The host's id of the video. |
| `autoPlay` | bool | `false` |  |  |

| `endAt` | int | unset |  |  |

<a id="node-audioPlayer"></a>
### `audioPlayer`

An audio player.

A network audio player (`just_audio`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |

| `url` | String | `""` |  | A remote HTTPS MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or AAC URL. |

| `playing` | bool | unset |  | Null leaves playback to autoPlay and the player's own controls. |
| `positionSeconds` | double | unset | ≥ 0 |  |
| `syncTolerance` | double | `0.3` | ≥ 0 | While playing, a changed `positionSeconds` seeks only when playback is more than this many seconds away from it (see `VideoProps.syncTolerance`). |

<a id="node-webView"></a>
### `webView`

`WebViewWidget`.

A web page (`webview_flutter`'s `WebViewWidget`).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sourceType` | [WebViewSourceType](#enum-WebViewSourceType) | `"url"` | `url`, `html`, `asset` |  |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | A URL, an HTML document or a Flutter asset path, per `sourceType`. |
| `embed` | Object | `{}` |  | The settings an embed (`{"type": "googleMaps"\|"twitter", ...}`) was generated from; `source` holds the generated HTML. |
| `gestures` | List<[WebViewGesture](#enum-WebViewGesture)> | `[]` | `verticalDrag`, `horizontalDrag`, `scale`, `tap`, `longPress`, `forcePress` |  |
| `allowsInlineMediaPlayback` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `mediaPlaybackRequiresUserAction` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](#type-Color) | unset |  |  |

<a id="action-print"></a>
### `print` (action): Print

Requests the platform print dialog for a rendered node. The user chooses the destination and confirms; this action never silently submits a job.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A rendered node to print through a user-confirmed platform dialog. |

<a id="action-preloadImages"></a>
### `preloadImages` (action): Preload images

Loads images ahead of showing them (a story's pages before reading), so they draw at once: `urls` is an expression giving a list of URLs (or a comma-separated text). While it runs, `progressVariable` (a variable's name; empty for none) holds the share done (0–1). It waits for every image and gives `{loaded, failed, total}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | String | `""` |  | The image URLs: a list (an expression) or comma-separated text. |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  | A variable to hold the share loaded (0-1) while it runs. |

<a id="action-speak"></a>
### `speak` (action): Speak

Reads `text` aloud, or `stop`s speaking. `rate` and `pitch` are numbers or expressions.

With `readAlong` the words are timed for a read-along highlight (`speech.wordIndex`): the text is said a phrase at a time, each word gets time by its syllables from the moment its phrase starts sounding, and the voice's word boundaries (when it reports them) snap the highlight to the real word and set the pace; without a voice the words are read along silently at that pace. It starts at `startWord` and the action waits until the text has been said (its result: `{completed: bool}`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `language` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `rate` | String | `"1"` |  | A number or expression. |
| `pitch` | String | `""` |  | A number or expression. |
| `stop` | bool | `false` |  | Stops speaking. |
| `readAlong` | bool | `false` |  | Times every word (speech.wordIndex) even when the voice reports no word boundaries, and reads along silently without a voice; the action waits until the text is said. |
| `startWord` | String | `""` |  | Read along: the word to start at (an index or expression), to carry on after a pause. |

<a id="action-playSound"></a>
### `playSound` (action): Play sound

Plays a synthesised `sound` (a voice name), now or `at` a time on the sound clock, or the sound file at `url`. Every field is an expression.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | String | `"wood"` |  | A synthesised voice name. |
| `operation` | String | `"play"` |  | play, start, stop, or stopAll. |
| `voiceId` | String | `""` |  | The independently owned sustained voice. |
| `frequency` | String | `"440"` |  | Sustained tone frequency in hertz. |
| `waveform` | String | `"sine"` |  | Sustained voice: sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, felt, reed or pluck. |
| `note` | String | `""` |  | A MIDI note number (60 = middle C) in place of frequency. |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | Milliseconds until a started voice releases itself; empty sustains. |
| `volume` | String | `"1"` |  |  |
| `pitch` | String | `"1"` |  |  |
| `at` | String | `""` |  | A time on the sound clock. |
| `url` | String | `""` |  | A sound file. |

<a id="action-captureScreenshot"></a>
### `captureScreenshot` (action): Capture screenshot

Captures what is on screen as a PNG image. `${result}` is `{"image": "data:image/png;base64,...", "width", "height"}` (in pixels): bind it to an image fill to show it, or upload it with a `cloudFiles` action whose `source` is `${result.image}`. JSON: `{"type": "captureScreenshot", "target": "app"}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | [CaptureTarget](#enum-CaptureTarget) | `"layout"` | `layout`, `node`, `app` | The screen, one of its nodes, or the whole app (in the host's capture scope). |
| `node` | String | `""` |  | The node captured (target node). |
| `pixelRatio` | double | `0` |  | Pixels per logical pixel; 0: the device's. |

<a id="action-downloadFile"></a>
### `downloadFile` (action): Download file

Exports generated UTF-8 text (CSV, JSON, plain text...) as a file. The browser downloads it; native apps show the platform save picker. Cancellation returns `{saved: false}` as the action result.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fileName` | String | `"export.txt"` |  | Suggested filename, an expression. |
| `text` | String | `""` |  | Generated file contents as UTF-8 text. |
| `mimeType` | String | `"text/plain"` |  |  |

<a id="media-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="media-control-a-player-from-state"></a>
### Control a player from state

Bind `props.playing` and `props.positionSeconds` to variables to play, pause and seek from buttons; the player's
`changed` trigger reports `ready`, `error`, the duration and the position.

<a id="media-save-a-file"></a>
### Save a file

`{"type": "downloadFile", "fileName": "trip.txt", "text": "${brief}", "mimeType": "text/plain"}` offers the text as
a file (the browser's download, a save dialog elsewhere); `${result.saved}` says whether it was saved. The keys are
`fileName` and `text` (not `filename`, `content`). The render command saves it under `<out>/downloads/` and lists it.

<a id="media-read-along-text"></a>
### Read-along text

`speak` with `readAlong` times the words for a highlight bound to the spoken word.

<a id="media-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Not in the agent trust profile at run time.
- The render command does not play media: a video draws its poster or nothing.

<a id="media-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Interaction](#page-interaction) · [decoration](#decoration-images) (still images are image fills).

<a id="page-engage"></a>
# Engage: app events and automations

<a id="engage-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

The `engage` feature library: firing app events that the project's automations listen for (a popup after a
lesson, a review prompt after the third order), and the `${usage}` counters they read.

<a id="engage-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["done"],
  "nodes": {
    "done": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "finish"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 120},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "finish": {
      "type": "filledButton",
      "layout": {"width": 200, "height": 48},
      "props": {"label": "Finish lesson", "style": {"backgroundColor": "#FF2563EB", "foregroundColor": "#FFFFFFFF"}},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "emitEvent", "event": "lessonFinished", "props": {"lesson": "intro"}}]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="engage-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="action-emitEvent"></a>
### `emitEvent` (action): Emit event

Fires app event `event` with `props` (text values are expressions) on the app's event bus: the project's automations listening for it run (a popup after the third order), and the host app hears it (`codelessly.events`). The same bus a host fires with `codelessly.emit(name, props)`. JSON: `{"type": "emitEvent", "event": "onboarding_done", "props": {"plan": "${plan}"}}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | String | `""` |  | The app event's name (an expression). |
| `props` | Object | unset |  | Its properties; text values are expressions. |

<a id="engage-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="engage-fire-an-event"></a>
### Fire an event

`{"type": "emitEvent", "event": "lessonFinished", "props": {"lesson": "intro"}}`: every automation of the project
listening for `lessonFinished` runs, reading `${event.props.lesson}` and `${usage.events.lessonFinished.count}`.
Automations live in the publish model, not in the document.

<a id="engage-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Not in the agent trust profile at run time.
- An event no automation listens for does nothing.

<a id="engage-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Publish](#page-publish) (the publish model) · [state](#page-state).

---

<a id="page-publish"></a>
# Publish, managed components and plugins

<a id="publish-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

What happens to documents after they are written: a published app's model (its layouts, components, theme and
identity), page paths and titles, components published by reference, managed component releases and hosted
plugins. Read it when you set a canvas's URL path or title, or ship components others reuse; the documents
themselves do not change.

<a id="publish-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A page whose canvas has a URL path and a name (its default title):

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "id": "pricing",
  "roots": ["pricing"],
  "nodes": {
    "pricing": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "name": "Pricing",
      "path": "pricing",
      "slots": {"body": "title"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 200},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"hug": 34}, "margin": 24},
      "props": {"text": "Pricing", "style": {"fontSize": 28, "fontWeight": 700, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="publish-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="publish-the-publish-model-s-parts"></a>
### The publish model's parts

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `PublishModel` | A published project: its layouts (by id, loaded on their own), entry screen, fonts, theme and APIs. |
| `PublishLayout` |  |
| `PublishComponent` | One published component definition (`publish/{p}/components/{id}`): its `document` (a component document: one root, a `widget` declaration) with its version and digest. |
| `PublishComponentInfo` | What a publish model knows of one published component without loading it: its version and digest (a cached copy with another digest is stale), when it was published and the fonts its text uses (loaded with the screens that call it). |
| `AppIdentity` | A published app's identity (the publish model's `appIdentity`). JSON: the identity's own (see the file comment), with every key this version doesn't model kept in `extra`. |
| `PageIdentity` | One page's (or screen's) title and description override, keyed in `AppIdentity.pages` by an editor page id, or a canvas or layout id. |
| `StyleSheet` | A project's style sheet (`style_sheets/{projectId}`, `schema: 2`). |
| `NamedTextStyle` | A named text style. |
| `CanvasBreakpoint` | Which project breakpoint a canvas of a layout is the design for (DESIGN.md §5.3). A layout with several canvases (one screen, one canvas per breakpoint) shows the one whose switch point is the highest at or below the width it's shown at (see `CanvasBreakpointsForWidth.forWidth`). |
| `PluginRef` | What a project uses of a hosted plugin: the channel it follows, an optional major pin, and the version (and its digest) the editor built and previewed with. JSON: `{"id": "codelessly.charts", "channel": "stable", "pin": 2, "version": 14, "semver": "2.3.1", "digest": "9f2c…"}`. |
| `Automation` | One automation of a project. Its `when` and its actions read the app's values (variables, `auth`, `storage`, `data`), `${event}` (`name`, `props`) and `${usage}`, the per-user counters the runtime keeps on the device:<br><br>- `usage.launches`, `usage.sessions`, `usage.firstSeen`, `usage.lastSeen` (ms since epoch), `usage.isFirstLaunch`, `usage.isFirstSession`;<br><br>- `usage.events.<name>.count` and `.last`: every app event fired;<br><br>- `usage.automations.<id>.count`, `.last` and `.session` (runs this session).<br><br>`maxRuns`, `maxPerSession` and `everyDays` limit how often it runs ("once", "once per session", "at most every 7 days"). |



<a id="publish-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="publish-a-page-s-url-and-title"></a>
### A page's URL and title

A canvas's `"path"` is its URL (`/pricing`); without one it gets a path from its name. The app identity's title
template (`${page.title} · ${app.name}`) makes each page's title; a page can override its title and description.

<a id="publish-components-by-reference"></a>
### Components by reference

A published site carries its components beside its pages; an app loads the ones a screen calls with the screen,
caches them, and follows a republished one: every instance updates where it is. Nothing to write in the
documents ([published components](#components-published-components)).

<a id="publish-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- The publish model is written by the editor and the publish tools, not by hand in a page document.
- A component's file must be named after its type.

<a id="publish-see-also"></a>
## See also

[Components](#page-components) · [engage](#page-engage) (automations live in the publish model) ·
[data](#page-data) (APIs live in the publish model).
